descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Your role The Taiwan Intermediary sales team is currently made up of professionals who prospect and service intermediary clients throughout Taiwan by marketing Pictet Asset Management’s (Pictet AM) strategies. Reporting to the Head of Sales - Taiwan, you will play a critical role in Pictet AM’s drive to further develop its business in Taiwan. Your responsibilities will be:
• Foster strong collaborative relationships with distributors and financial advisors to boost sales activities.
• Address and assist distributors' headquarters and clients in resolving product and market-related inquiries while nurturing relationships.
• Organize seminars and meetings to facilitate engagement and knowledge sharing.
• Actively participate in fund sales initiatives and strive to partner with distributors in campaigns to achieve the company's business goals and increase brand awareness.
• Regularly visit branches for fund promotion and training.
• Gather, organize, analyse, and share market intelligence related to distributors and industry peers.
• Contribute to the development of effective sales strategies based on market insights.
• Proactively carry out tasks assigned by the sales head, ensuring efficient and accurate completion of various assignments.
• Maintain various documents, including updating client contact information, preparing call reports, and documenting activity notes in Salesforce (SF). Your profile
• Hold a university degree or higher, with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in the financial industry.
• Have a deep understanding of various mutual fund products, such as equity, fixed-income, private equity and ETFs.
• Possess excellent interpersonal skills that foster effective teamwork and communication.
• Exhibit strong presentation skills to deliver persuasive sales pitches.
• Demonstrate problem-solving abilities and a strong sense of responsibility and commitment to the business. As the successful applicant you will show drive, have a keen entrepreneurial spirit and be able to develop successful business relationships and close deals. You will also have a flair for communication, be able to manage priorities and multi-task on different projects concurrently, as well as having an eye for detail. Working in a self-reliant manner in a broader team makes you excel. You will be joining a structured and highly motivated team. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Business Compliace Manager The successful candidate will join a team whose principal function is to analyse and perform control activities related to anti-money laundering (AML) and business risks. Your role The function will, amongst other tasks, assist the Chief Risk Officer & MLRO with:
• Promoting a strong compliance culture within the Bank.
• Reviewing new account applications for compliance with KYC requirements.
• Completing risk ratings of new accounts.
• Periodic reviews of existing customer accounts.
• Identification and review of unusual transactions.
• Review and analysis of name screening alerts.
• Reporting of key performamce indicators. Your profile
• Strong analytical skills.
• Ability to work independently and under pressure to meet strict deadlines.
• Must be a team player.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Excellent problem solving and organizational skills.
• Excellent research and analytical skills.
• Proficiency in a variety of software applications including Microsoft Office.
• At least five (5) years compliance or audit experience in a Private Bank or Trust Company.
• University degree (Banking, Finance, Law, Business Administration or a related field).
• Professional qualification (ICA International Compliance and Anti-Money Laundering Diplomas or ACAMS Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Certification).
• Experience in the preparation of information reports.
• In-depth knowledge of The Bank & Trust Companies Regulation Act, 2020. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. titleByLocale.it: Senior Compliance Officer (Contratto a tempo determinato - 12 mesi)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Organisation & Digital, Risk and Tax departments. The Corporate Compliance Officer participates in monitoring the company's activities to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and also takes part in the implementation of the CMP (Control Monitoring Plan). He also ensures the strengthening of the company's procedural and training framework. Your role
• Analyze regulatory watch screenings performing gap analysis on new regulations and assess their potential impact within the company.
• Contribute to the development and implementation of the Compliance Monitoring Plan by identifying applicable compliance standards and monitoring controls using a risk-based approach.
• Identify and assess compliance risks to which the company is exposed, make appropriate observations, and verify appropriate follow up on related to identified issues with the different stakeholders.
• Assist in establishing and maintaining a compliance manual, ensuring that all internal policies and procedures comply with legal requirements and group minimum standards.
• Assist in the training of new employees on compliance topics and ensure that compliance training is conducted at defined intervals.
• Participate in regulatory projects by providing advice on legal requirements and ensuring that delivered solutions comply with regulations and minimum group standards.
• Maintain and update various registers, including investor complaints, conflicts of interest, personal transactions, gifts, and identified issues.
• Follow up on audit recommendations and participate in the proper implementation.
• Collaborate with regulators and the Ministry of Finance to ensure compliance and respond to regulatory requests. Your profile Please insert the text for the job ad to be then published internally/externally Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. As part of the Client Register team , you will contribute to the management and integrity of client data, supporting the bank’s core operations and ensuring a high standard of service for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams, without direct contact with clients. Your main responsibilities will include managing the opening and closing of customer accounts for the bank and its branches, as well as handling credit card administration for customers. This involves updating static data and the services selected by our clients and performing “Cotation” tasks such as signature verification. In addition, you will play a central role in the transformation of our activities by driving the identification, implementation, and optimization of automation and digitalization solutions for our processes. You will ensure strict adherence to internal procedures and regulatory requirements, while supporting the various business lines of the Bank. Your role
• Play a key role in managing client account openings and updates for individuals, legal entities, and trusts, ensuring a seamless client experience.
• Strive for excellence in data quality and completeness, supporting both business growth and regulatory requirements.
• Take charge of credit card administration, working closely with service providers to deliver efficient solutions.
• Perform analysis of account structures and verification of client signatures to ensure the validity and compliance of payment instructions.
• Make a real impact by contributing to data remediation initiatives and maintaining accurate client records.
• Be proactive in improving departmental procedures, keeping us aligned with the latest industry standards.
• Embrace digital transformation by supporting the adoption of automation and AI solutions.
• Foster consistency and efficiency by promoting process harmonization across the Group.
• Get involved in projects that drive innovation and enhance client data management.
• Collaborate with dedicated colleagues and key stakeholders across the business.
• Be a valued partner, responding to requests from all business lines regarding Client Register activities. Your profile Requested experience:
• Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree, ideally complemented by initial experience in the banking sector (Operations) Soft skills:
• Meticulous, detail-oriented, and organized, delivering work of the highest quality.
• Dynamic, proactive in problem-solving, and demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit.
• Able to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.
• Discreet and able to handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost professionalism. Technical skills:
• Proficient in standard MS Office products.
• Interest in automation, digitalization, and new technologies, with the ability to design, maintain, or improve automated operational tools (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, AI agents, etc.), while adhering to security and compliance standards is a strong asset. Language skills:
• Fluent in written and spoken French. Good command of English. German is an asset. Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. • Make a real impact by contributing to data remediation initiatives and maintaining accurate client records.
• Be proactive in improving departmental procedures, keeping us aligned with the latest industry standards.
• Embrace digital transformation by supporting the adoption of automation and AI solutions.
• Foster consistency and efficiency by promoting process harmonization across the Group.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra Le funzioni aziendali includono le attività non bancarie del Gruppo e impiega oltre 600 persone. Queste funzioni sono svolte da specialisti con competenze in tutte le unità aziendali, e includono le comunicazioni, conformità, finanza, risorse umane, sicurezza dell'informazione, controllo interno, legale, strategia e progetti, dipartimenti di rischio e fiscale. In questo ruolo, guiderai e coordinerai più progetti di Risk & Compliance interfunzionali e sensibili a livello del Gruppo, guidandoli da punti di vista strategici, operativi e organizzativi. Si lavorerà in stretta collaborazione con Business Lines, entità di Gruppo e il responsabile del gruppo per garantire l'effettiva esecuzione e la consegna di iniziative critiche. Le tue responsabilità includono la guida della governance del progetto, la promozione della collaborazione tra le squadre e l’allineamento con gli obiettivi generali del Gruppo. Il tuo ruolo - Progetti e programmi di gestione dei cambiamenti di piombo, tra cui la definizione di ruoli e responsabilità, la definizione della governance del progetto, la garanzia della qualità dei responsabili, la gestione dei bilanci, la valutazione dei rischi e la progettazione di nuovi processi. - Coordinare la comunicazione con gli stakeholder, organizzare sessioni di formazione e garantire una comprensione approfondita delle esigenze e dei requisiti aziendali. - Proporre e sviluppare soluzioni innovative, formulare raccomandazioni attuabili, implementare modifiche e monitorare tempi e pietre miliari del progetto. - Preparare e presentare aggiornamenti regolari del progetto alla gestione senior e agli stakeholder. - Contribuire allo sviluppo di nuove soluzioni e definire i prossimi passi per iniziative in corso. - Proattivamente sfidare le pratiche commerciali esistenti, suggerire miglioramenti o nuovi programmi, e prendere la piena proprietà dei responsabili. - Identificare, valutare e implementare nuovi servizi e strumenti per migliorare l'efficienza operativa. Il tuo profilo - Laurea magistrale o equivalente. - Esperienza minima di 10 anni nella gestione del progetto, idealmente all’interno di imprese di consulenza e/o strategia. L'esperienza nel settore finanziario o bancario è un bene forte. - Interesse per l'analisi dei dati e strumenti di business intelligence (ad esempio Tableau, BO), capacità di lavorare con AI, machine learning e tecnologie di automazione. - Prove agilità di apprendimento e adattabilità per prosperare in un panorama tecnologico e finanziario in rapida evoluzione. - Altamente automotivato e autonomo, con forte pensiero concettuale, una mentalità imprenditoriale, e eccezionali capacità analitiche e problem solving. - Eccellente capacità di gestione interpersonale e degli stakeholder, con un track record di collaborazione efficace in ambienti diversi e interfunzionali. - Completa competenza professionale sia in francese che in inglese, scritta e parlata. - Dev'essere residente in Svizzera. Come candidato di successo, si dovrebbe essere soluzioni orientate con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, approfondito nel vostro approccio al vostro lavoro e in grado di mostrare l'iniziativa. Potrai anche possedere eccellenti competenze tecniche analitiche e forti insieme a comprovate capacità diplomatiche e interpersonali. Inoltre, sei in grado di lavorare autonomamente mostrando un forte spirito di squadra. Nota Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie. SPM/MH/PM Diversità e inclusione Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione sul posto di lavoro. Applicare Salva lavoro Email a un contatto Torna alla lista

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include the Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Strategy & Projects, Risk and Tax departments. In this role, you will lead and coordinate multiple sensitive and complex cross-functional Risk & Compliance projects at the Group level, steering them from strategic, operational, and organizational standpoints. You will work in close partnership with Business Lines, Group entities, and the Group Chief Risk Officer to ensure the effective execution and successful delivery of critical initiatives. Your responsibilities will include driving project governance, fostering collaboration across teams, and ensuring alignment with the Group’s overall objectives. Your role
• Lead change management projects and programs, including defining roles and responsibilities, establishing project governance, ensuring the quality of deliverables, managing budgets, assessing risks, and designing new processes.
• Coordinate communication with stakeholders, organize training sessions, and ensure a thorough understanding of business needs and requirements.
• Propose and develop innovative solutions, make actionable recommendations, implement changes, and monitor project timelines and milestones.
• Prepare and present regular project updates to senior management and stakeholders.
• Contribute to the development of new solutions and define next steps for ongoing initiatives.
• Proactively challenge existing business practices, suggest improvements or new programs, and take full ownership of deliverables.
• Identify, evaluate, and implement new services and tools to enhance operational efficiency. Your profile
• Master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
• Minimum of 10 years’ experience in project management, ideally within consulting and/or strategy firms. Experience in the financial or banking industry is a strong asset.
• Interest in data analytics and business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, BO), ability to work with AI, machine learning, and automation technologies.
• Proven learning agility and adaptability to thrive in a rapidly evolving technological and financial landscape.
• Highly self-motivated and autonomous, with strong conceptual thinking, an entrepreneurial mindset, and exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of effective collaboration in diverse, cross-functional environments.
• Full professional proficiency in both French and English, written and spoken.
• Must be resident in Switzerland. As the successful candidate, you should be solutions oriented with excellent communication skills, thorough in your approach to your work and capable of showing initiative. You will also possess excellent analytical and strong technical skills together with proven diplomatic and interpersonal skills. Furthermore, you are able to work autonomously while showing a strong team-spirit. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. SPM/MH/PM Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Dein Team Corporate Functions umfasst die Nichtbankaktivitäten der Gruppe und beschäftigt mehr als 600 Mitarbeiter. Diese Funktionen werden von Spezialisten mit Fachwissen in allen Geschäftsbereichen ausgeführt und umfassen die Abteilungen Kommunikation, Compliance, Finanzen, Personal, Informationssicherheit, interne Revision, Recht, Strategie & Projekte, Risiko und Steuern. In dieser Funktion leiten und koordinieren Sie mehrere sensible und komplexe funktionsübergreifende Risk & Compliance-Projekte auf Gruppenebene und steuern sie aus strategischer, operativer und organisatorischer Sicht. Sie arbeiten eng mit Business Lines, Konzerngesellschaften und dem Group Chief Risk Officer zusammen, um die effektive Durchführung und erfolgreiche Umsetzung kritischer Initiativen sicherzustellen. Ihre Aufgaben umfassen die Förderung der Projektsteuerung, die Förderung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Teams und die Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung auf die Gesamtziele der Gruppe. Deine Rolle Führen Sie Change Management-Projekte und -Programme, einschließlich der Definition von Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, der Festlegung von Projekt-Governance, der Sicherstellung der Qualität der Ergebnisse, der Verwaltung von Budgets, der Bewertung von Risiken und der Gestaltung neuer Prozesse. Koordinieren Sie die Kommunikation mit den Stakeholdern, organisieren Sie Schulungen und sorgen Sie für ein gründliches Verständnis der geschäftlichen Bedürfnisse und Anforderungen. - Vorschlagen und Entwickeln innovativer Lösungen, umsetzbare Empfehlungen, Implementierung von Änderungen und Überwachung von Projektzeitplänen und Meilensteinen. Bereiten Sie regelmäßige Projektaktualisierungen für die Geschäftsleitung und die Stakeholder vor. - Tragen Sie zur Entwicklung neuer Lösungen bei und definieren Sie die nächsten Schritte für laufende Initiativen. - Bestehende Geschäftspraktiken proaktiv herausfordern, Verbesserungen oder neue Programme vorschlagen und das volle Eigentum an den zu erbringenden Leistungen übernehmen. Identifizieren, bewerten und implementieren Sie neue Dienste und Tools, um die betriebliche Effizienz zu verbessern. Dein Profil - Master-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation. - Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise in Beratungs- und / oder Strategieunternehmen. Erfahrung in der Finanz- oder Bankenbranche ist ein starkes Kapital. - Interesse an Data Analytics und Business Intelligence Tools (z. B. Tableau, BO), der Fähigkeit, mit KI zu arbeiten, maschinellem Lernen und Automatisierungstechnologien. Bewährte Lernfähigkeit und Anpassungsfähigkeit, um in einer sich schnell entwickelnden technologischen und finanziellen Landschaft zu gedeihen. - Sehr selbstmotiviert und autonom, mit starkem konzeptionellem Denken, einer unternehmerischen Denkweise und außergewöhnlichen analytischen und problemlösenden Fähigkeiten. - Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz der effektiven Zusammenarbeit in verschiedenen, funktionsübergreifenden Umgebungen. - Volle professionelle Kenntnisse in Französisch und Englisch, geschrieben und gesprochen. Muss in der Schweiz wohnen. Als erfolgreicher Kandidat sollten Sie mit hervorragenden Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, gründlich in Ihrer Herangehensweise an Ihre Arbeit und in der Lage sein, Initiative zu zeigen, lösungsorientiert sein. Sie werden auch ausgezeichnete analytische und starke technische Fähigkeiten zusammen mit bewährten diplomatischen und zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten besitzen. Darüber hinaus können Sie autonom arbeiten und gleichzeitig einen starken Teamgeist zeigen. Anmerkung: Wir werden keine CVs über Agenturen akzeptieren. Votre équipe Les fonctions d'entreprise comprennent les activités non bancaires du Groupe et emploient plus de 600 personnes. Ces fonctions sont exercées par des spécialistes spécialisés dans toutes les unités opérationnelles et comprennent les services des communications, de la conformité, des finances, des ressources humaines, de la sécurité de l'information, de la vérification interne, des services juridiques, de la stratégie et des projets, du risque et de l'impôt. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez et coordonnerez de multiples projets interfonctionnels sensibles et complexes de gestion des risques et de conformité au niveau du Groupe, en les dirigeant d'un point de vue stratégique, opérationnel et organisationnel. Vous travaillerez en partenariat étroit avec les secteurs d'activité, les entités du Groupe et le chef de la direction des risques du Groupe pour assurer l'exécution efficace et la mise en oeuvre réussie des initiatives essentielles. Vos responsabilités comprendront la conduite des projets, la promotion de la collaboration entre les équipes et l'harmonisation avec les objectifs généraux du Groupe. Tableau, BO), la capacité de travailler avec l'IA, l'apprentissage automatique et les technologies d'automatisation. - Capacité d'apprentissage éprouvée et adaptabilité pour prospérer dans un contexte technologique et financier en évolution rapide. - Très motivé et autonome, avec une pensée conceptuelle forte, une mentalité entrepreneuriale et des capacités exceptionnelles d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes. - Excellentes compétences en gestion des relations interpersonnelles et des parties prenantes, avec un bilan de collaboration efficace dans divers environnements interfonctionnels. - Compétence professionnelle complète en français et en anglais, écrite et parlée. - Il doit résider en Suisse. La tua squadra Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 200 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà dei partner offre un'offerta completa per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare. Come consulente diretto, si delinea la vista del CIO Office e la vista casa della Banca ai clienti, fornendo supporto commerciale e consulenza pro-attiva. Risponderai anche alle domande dei clienti e risponderai alle richieste di informazioni, nel rispetto delle procedure applicabili e delle regole interne/esterne. Il tuo ruolo
• Fornire clienti privati con stretto accesso al mercato e rapido accesso al piano di trading.
• Offrire consigli e rispondere alle richieste e alle domande dei clienti.
• Consultare i clienti con strategie di investimento tattico e idee di trading in tutte le classi di asset.
• Offrire ai clienti l'accesso a una selezione di pubblicazioni finanziarie e commerciali, e traducendo le informazioni acquisite in idee di investimento.
• Tenere al passo con gli ultimi sviluppi sui mercati finanziari e sull'ambiente macro.
• Interpretare rapporti finanziari/commerciali, nonché valutare l'analisi dei dati.
• Monitoraggio delle posizioni dei clienti al fine di ottimizzare le prestazioni e adeguarle per tener conto del rischio.
• Fornire un feedback costante ai CRM dei clienti e ad altri principali stakeholder.
• Mantenere una forte cultura di conformità. Garantire la conformità ottimale e la gestione dei rischi, aderendo a tutte le normative locali applicabili, disposizioni normative, direttive e procedure interne come prima linea di difesa.
• Mantenere il rispetto degli sviluppi nei campi in modo da poterli applicare in modo efficace e garantire un trattamento equo di tutti i clienti, pur aderiscendo anche alla missione e ai valori fondamentali di Pictet. Il tuo profilo
• Una laurea: idealmente laurea o una qualifica post-laurea come un CFA.
• Almeno 10 anni di esperienza in una funzione simile.
• Un forte background dei mercati finanziari con una forte conoscenza delle classi di asset.
• Conoscenza avanzata dei prodotti e servizi finanziari con solida esperienza sui derivati.
• Conoscenza approfondita dell’offerta della Banca.
• Francese fluente e inglese; la buona conoscenza di altre lingue sarebbe un plus.
• Eccellente capacità IT, in particolare Avaloq, Athena, Bloomberg e MS Excel.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) è uno specialista di investimento alternativo leader e interamente controllata del Gruppo Pictet, con competenze in fondi di copertura, private equity e immobili globali. Con i team di tutto il mondo, i team PAA costruiscono, gestiscono e consigliano portafogli di soluzioni di investimento alternative per clienti istituzionali e privati. Sarete parte di un team di 20 professionisti dedicati al franchise paneuropeo Direct Real Estate di Pictet, iniziato nel 2019 con il lancio di Elevation Fund I, un fondo di valore di 700 milioni di euro. Elevation Fund II è stato lanciato nel 2023, e un fondo Core Plus, con circa 200 milioni di euro sotto la gestione, è stato lanciato nel 2021. Il team è distribuito in diverse sedi: a Londra, dove si basano i principali team di investimento e asset management; a Ginevra, dove operano i team di investimento legali e di relazioni con gli investitori; e a Berlino, Stoccolma e Madrid, dove si trovano i nostri capi regionali. Inoltre, le funzioni di sostegno dei fondi come l'amministrazione dei fondi, la conformità e le questioni legali sono situate in Lussemburgo. Con sede a Ginevra o a Londra, lavorerai a stretto contatto con il Senior Legal Advisor che copre l'attività di Direct Real Estate per sostenere l'attività durante il congedo di maternità del nostro Legal Advisor. Il tuo ruolo
• Guidare la revisione, la redazione e la negoziazione di una vasta gamma di documenti immobiliari e finanziari, compresi gli accordi degli azionisti, accordi di finanziamento, accordi di locazione, SPA, accordi di costruzione, ecc.
• Sostenere le transazioni immobiliari dirette dall'inizio alla chiusura, contribuendo a guidare l'esecuzione coordinando i flussi di lavoro legali, gestendo i negoziati e liaising con gli stakeholder interni e i consulenti esterni.
• Agire come partner legale chiave in materia transfrontaliera, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team interni di tutte le giurisdizioni sullo stato delle transazioni, la documentazione, la meccanica dei pagamenti e le relative fasi di esecuzione. Sarebbe importante dimostrare di aver condotto transazioni in almeno 3 diverse giurisdizioni.
• Fornire assistenza legale quotidiana in materia di asset management e di progetto, combinando una forte stesura legale tecnica con un approccio pratico e orientato alle soluzioni alle questioni aziendali. La mentalità orientata agli affari trova soluzioni ai problemi del nostro team invece di agire solo come portiere.
• Guidare e sostenere la documentazione legale per le questioni di sviluppo, costruzione e ristrutturazione, tra cui la preparazione, la revisione e la finalizzazione dei progetti e dei contratti di lavoro per le controparti. Il tuo profilo
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza (post-qualifica) nel reparto immobiliare di uno studio legale importante e rispettabile.
• Rigoroso, con ottime capacità di numerazione e un'attenta attenzione ai dettagli.
• Un forte interesse per e/o esperienza con l'AI sarebbe un bene.
• La fluenza in inglese è un must, francese, spagnolo, tedesco o danese sarebbe un bene.

Your team Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment specialist and wholly owned subsidiary of the Pictet Group, with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. With teams based around the world, the PAA teams construct, manage and advise on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients. You will be part of a team of 20 professionals dedicated to Pictet’s pan-European Direct Real Estate franchise, which began in 2019 with the launch of Elevation Fund I, a EUR 700 million value-add fund. Elevation Fund II was launched in 2023, and a Core Plus fund, with approximately EUR 200 million under management, was launched in 2021. The team is distributed across several locations: in London, where the core investment and asset management teams are based; in Geneva, where the investment legal and investor relations teams operate; and in Berlin, Stockholm, and Madrid, where our regional heads are located. Additionally, fund support functions such as fund administration, compliance, and legal affairs are situated in Luxembourg. Based in Geneva or London, you will work closely with the Senior Legal Advisor covering the Direct Real Estate activity to support the activity during the maternity leave of our Legal Advisor. Your role
• Lead the review, drafting and negotiation of a wide range of real estate and financing documents, including shareholders’ agreements, financing agreements, lease agreements, SPAs, construction agreements, etc.
• Support direct real estate transactions from inception to closing, helping to drive execution by coordinating legal workstreams, managing negotiations and liaising with internal stakeholders and external advisers.
• Act as a key legal partner on cross-border matters, working closely with internal teams across jurisdictions on transaction status, documentation, payment mechanics and related execution steps. It would be important to evidence having led transactions in at least 3 different jurisdictions.
• Provide day-to-day legal support on asset management and project matters, combining strong technical legal drafting with a practical, solutions-oriented approach to business issues. Business oriented mindset finding solutions to our team’s problems instead of acting only as a gatekeeper.
• Lead and support legal documentation for development, construction and refurbishment matters, including preparing, revising and finalising project and works contracts for counterparties. Your profile
• At least 5 years’ experience (post-qualification) in the real estate department of a major and reputable law firm.
• Rigorous, with excellent numeracy skills and a keen attention to detail.
• A strong interest in and/or experience with AI would be an asset.
• Fluency in English is a must, French, Spanish, German or Danish would be an asset.
• The role can be located in London or in Geneva. descriptionByLocale.it: Il vostro team Pictet Trading & Sales (PTS) offre l'accesso diretto ai mercati globali, offrendo soluzioni di trading su misura in una vasta gamma di asset class. I nostri team di commercianti di vendita, specialisti IT, strateghi e analisti quantistici sono assistiti da una suite completa di funzioni di rischio e di controllo e dall'ultima tecnologia. Al centro dell'attività dei derivati PTS Al centro dell'attività dei derivati PTS, nell'ambito del team Middle Office – Derivatives, possederai l'integrità e le prestazioni delle operazioni ETD, OTC e dei prodotti strutturati. Ti assicurerai che gli scambi e gli eventi del ciclo di vita fluiscano con precisione ed efficienza e risolvano problemi operativi complessi. Al di là delle operazioni quotidiane, aiuterà a guidare l'automazione e ridisegnare i flussi di lavoro per costruire un modello operativo più scalabile, resiliente e ad alto rendimento. Il vostro ruolo - Proprio l'integrità giorno per giorno delle operazioni derivate attraverso prodotti ETD e OTC, assicurando un accurato follow-up di prenotazione e una gestione robusta del ciclo di vita. - Indagare e risolvere i problemi di prenotazione, ciclo di vita e riconciliazione; identificare le cause principali e contribuire a soluzioni permanenti e scalabili. - Agire come partner operativo chiave per Trading Desks (Agenzia e Principal Trading), fornendo un supporto tempestivo e affidabile su questioni commerciali. - Mantenere un servizio di alta qualità con entità interne come PTS, PWM, PAS, POI e Operazioni. - Contribuire all'automazione, alla standardizzazione e all'ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro operativi. Il tuo profilo - 3/5 anni di esperienza professionale con le classi di asset ETD e OTC, compresi i prodotti strutturati. - Ottima conoscenza delle classi di asset ETD e OTC e buona conoscenza del settore bancario. - Capacità di priorità in modo efficace e adattarsi in un ambiente di trading veloce. - Forte capacità organizzative e di comunicazione - Comodo funzionamento sotto pressione in un ambiente dinamico di trading-pavimento - Approfondito interesse per il miglioramento dei processi, l'automazione, e sfruttando i dati e soluzioni AI-driven per migliorare l'efficienza operativa e la scalabilità - La conoscenza di Front Arena, Bloomberg, Avaloq o Lexifi è considerata un bene. - Fluente in inglese, una seconda lingua è un vantaggio. - Residenza svizzera o disposta a trasferirsi. Questo ruolo offre un'opportunità unica per lavorare al centro dell'attività dei derivati all'interno di PTS, combinando la proprietà operativa, problem-solving e miglioramento continuo. Si otterrà un'ampia esposizione in ETD, OTC e prodotti strutturati, contribuendo allo sviluppo di un modello operativo più automatizzato, efficiente e scalabile in stretta interazione con il piano di trading. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team Pictet Trading & Sales (PTS) provides direct access to global markets, offering bespoke trading solutions across a wide range of asset classes. Our teams of sales traders, IT specialists, strategists and quant analysts are assisted by a full suite of risk and control functions as well as the latest technology. At the core of PTS derivatives activity, as part of the Middle Office – Derivatives team, you will own the integrity and performance of ETD, OTC, and structured products operations. You will ensure trades and lifecycle events flow accurately and efficiently and solve complex operational problems. Beyond daily operations, you will help drive automation and redesign workflows to build a more scalable, resilient, and high-performing operating model. Your role
• Own the day-to-day integrity of derivatives operations across ETD and OTC products, ensuring accurate booking follow-up and robust lifecycle management.
• Investigate and resolve booking, lifecycle, and reconciliation issues; identify root causes and contribute to permanent, scalable solutions.
• Act as a key operational partner to Trading Desks (Agency and Principal Trading), providing timely and reliable support on trade-related matters.
• Maintaining a high-quality service with internal entities as PTS, PWM, PAS, POI and Operations.
• Contribute to the automation, standardization, and optimization of operational workflows. Your profile
• 3/5 years professional experience with ETD and OTC asset classes, including structured products.
• Excellent knowledge of ETD and OTC asset classes and good knowledge of banking industry.
• Ability to prioritize effectively and adapt in a fast-paced trading environment.
• Strong organizational and communication skills
• Comfortable operating under pressure in a dynamic trading-floor environment
• Proven interest in process improvement, automation, and leveraging data and AI-driven solutions to enhance operational efficiency and scalability
• Knowledge of Front Arena, Bloomberg, Avaloq or Lexifi is considered an asset.
• Fluent in English, a second language is a plus.
• Swiss residency or willing to relocate. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the center of derivatives activity within PTS, combining operational ownership, problem-solving, and continuous improvement. You will gain broad exposure across ETD, OTC, and structured products while contributing to the evolution of a more automated, efficient, and scalable operating model in close interaction with the trading floor. Start date: ASAP Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

We are an independent investment partnership known for our long-term mindset, responsible approach to business, and entrepreneurial spirit. These principles have defined us since 1805. For our clients, colleagues and wider society, we always aim to do the right thing and honour our commitment to enduring quality.

Pictet opened its Tokyo office in 1981 to conduct research on the Japanese economy and equity market. It began providing asset management services to institutional investors in 1987 and entered the investment trust (mutual fund) business in 1997. As of the end of March 2026, the firm’s assets under management totaled 4.56 trillion yen.

Your role

We are seeking an economist to lead our global research and analysis on macroeconomics, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange.

Key responsibilities include preparing reports and presentation materials on macroeconomic and financial market developments; delivering presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media; and providing clear explanations and interpretive support during client meetings.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills and excellent communication abilities, with the proven ability to convey complex information effectively in both English and Japanese.

Responsibilities

• Conduct in-depth analysis of macroeconomic trends, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange in Japan and globally

• Prepare reports and presentation materials for both internal and external stakeholders

• Deliver presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media

• Provide clear explanations and interpretation support during client meetings

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree or higher

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as an economist

• Deep understanding of macroeconomics and financial markets

• Native-level proficiency in Japanese and business-level or higher proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking)

• Excellent report writing and presentation skills

• Demonstrated experience in client-facing roles

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Certified Member Analyst of the Securities Analysts Association of Japan (CMA) or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)

• Bloomberg

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

As part of the Client Register team , you will contribute to the management and integrity of client data, supporting the bank’s core operations and ensuring a high standard of service for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams, without direct contact with clients.

Your main responsibilities will include managing the opening and closing of customer accounts for the bank and its branches, as well as handling credit card administration for customers. This involves updating static data and the services selected by our clients and performing “Cotation” tasks such as signature verification.

In addition, you will play a central role in the transformation of our activities by driving the identification, implementation, and optimization of automation and digitalization solutions for our processes. You will ensure strict adherence to internal procedures and regulatory requirements, while supporting the various business lines of the Bank.

Your role

• Play a key role in managing client account openings and updates for individuals, legal entities, and trusts, ensuring a seamless client experience.

• Strive for excellence in data quality and completeness, supporting both business growth and regulatory requirements.

• Take charge of credit card administration, working closely with service providers to deliver efficient solutions.

• Perform analysis of account structures and verification of client signatures to ensure the validity and compliance of payment instructions.

• Make a real impact by contributing to data remediation initiatives and maintaining accurate client records.

• Be proactive in improving departmental procedures, keeping us aligned with the latest industry standards.

• Embrace digital transformation by supporting the adoption of automation and AI solutions.

• Foster consistency and efficiency by promoting process harmonization across the Group.

• Get involved in projects that drive innovation and enhance client data management.

• Collaborate with dedicated colleagues and key stakeholders across the business.

• Be a valued partner, responding to requests from all business lines regarding Client Register activities.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree, ideally complemented by initial experience in the banking sector (Operations)

Soft skills:

• Meticulous, detail-oriented, and organized, delivering work of the highest quality.

• Dynamic, proactive in problem-solving, and demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit.

• Able to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.

• Discreet and able to handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost professionalism.

Technical skills:

• Proficient in standard MS Office products.

• Interest in automation, digitalization, and new technologies, with the ability to design, maintain, or improve automated operational tools (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, AI agents, etc.), while adhering to security and compliance standards is a strong asset.

Language skills:

• Fluent in written and spoken French. Good command of English. German is an asset.

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Your team Pictet Asset Management manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions,financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service. The Investment Reporting team serves institutional clients and financial intermediaries through three core pillars: producing high‑quality client and marketing documents; promoting an exceptional client experience by providing customized and timely solutions; and innovating to continuously improve how documents are designed, produced and distributed. Your role Production of documents
• Deliver high‑quality investment reports, marketing materials and client presentations with a strong focus on accuracy, consistency and timeliness.
• Own end‑to‑end production topics: manage priorities with stakeholders,anticipate bottlenecks, and ensure reliable delivery during peak periods.
• Contribute to strengthening production robustness through ongoing process improvements.
• Play an integral role in the migration of existing reports to the Vermilion Reporting Suite (VRS) and the transition of our data to Snowflake. Client Experience Enhancement
• Improve client satisfaction by raising quality standards and service responsiveness.
• Evolve reports, templates and content to enhance investment insights, increase clarity, storytelling and visual impact for our clients.
• Partner with Sales and Investment teams for client meetings/reviews and translate feedback into concrete improvements in reporting output and service practices. Reporting Innovation
• Identify pragmatic opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate recurring tasks to improve efficiency and quality at scale by using technology. Your profile We’re looking for a proactive, motivated and skilled individual who brings analytical thinking, technical skills to support modern reporting, a client mindset, and a collaborative approach. The ideal candidate will have:
• A university degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics , or a related field.
• A solid understanding of financial markets , with experience in investment reporting / client reporting or a similar environment with a strong focus on Fixed Income and Multi-Asset.
• Strong analytical problem-solving skills , high attention to detail , and a proven quality mindset.
• Comfortable working independently , taking ownership, and collaborating effectively across teams and locations.
• Ability to translate complex investment data into clear, visually compelling client-facing material.
• Advanced SQL, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Experience with VRS / Snowflake / Tableau is a strong asset.
• Strong interest in new technology and AI / GenAI, applied to automation, quality controls and innovation generation, Python highly valued. Your role Production of documents
• Deliver high‑quality investment reports, marketing materials and client presentations with a strong focus on accuracy, consistency and timeliness.
• Own end‑to‑end production topics: manage priorities with stakeholders,anticipate bottlenecks, and ensure reliable delivery during peak periods.
• Contribute to strengthening production robustness through ongoing process improvements.
• Play an integral role in the migration of existing reports to the Vermilion Reporting Suite (VRS) and the transition of our data to Snowflake. Client Experience Enhancement
• Improve client satisfaction by raising quality standards and service responsiveness.
• Evolve reports, templates and content to enhance investment insights, increase clarity, storytelling and visual impact for our clients.
• Partner with Sales and Investment teams for client meetings/reviews and translate feedback into concrete improvements in reporting output and service practices. Reporting Innovation
• Identify pragmatic opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate recurring tasks to improve efficiency and quality at scale by using technology. Your profile We’re looking for a proactive, motivated and skilled individual who brings analytical thinking, technical skills to support modern reporting, a client mindset, and a collaborative approach. The ideal candidate will have:
• A university degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics , or a related field.
• A solid understanding of financial markets , with experience in investment reporting / client reporting or a similar environment with a strong focus on Fixed Income and Multi-Asset.
• Strong analytical problem-solving skills , high attention to detail , and a proven quality mindset.
• Comfortable working independently , taking ownership, and collaborating effectively across teams and locations.
• Ability to translate complex investment data into clear, visually compelling client-facing material.
• Advanced SQL, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Experience with VRS / Snowflake / Tableau is a strong asset.
• Strong interest in new technology and AI / GenAI, applied to automation, quality controls and innovation generation, Python highly valued. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people. The Compliance function is responsible for helping Pictet’s senior management manage the compliance risks faced by Pictet. This role will focus on the risks faced by Pictet’s Singapore bank, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch. The AML/CFT Compliance Officer is part of the team that oversees the Bank’s financial crime framework, focused primarily on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance. The incumbent performs systematic AML/CFT reviews on high-risk clients before onboarding and subsequent periodic reviews, reviews alerts/issues escalated by first-line functions and reports suspicions of criminal or sanctioned activity, and provides advice on AML/CFT and sanctions management. . The officer monitors changes that may impact the business, working with business and support functions to ensure that the Bank complies with regulatory obligations and Group standards in the financial crime area. The role will report to the Compliance AML Lead. Your role Key responsibilities -Investigate relevant alerts and suspicious activities, and perform filing of STR to local authorities. -Perform ex-ante AML reviews on high-risk client onboarding and periodic reviews. -Review escalated alerts from first-line transaction monitoring, payment filtering and ongoing name screening controls. -Support external requests include production orders, due diligence queries and any relevant regulatory reporting (e.g. Remote Gambling Act reporting). -Act as an expert advisor to business and support functions on compliance and regulatory matters related to AML/CFT and international sanctions management. -Perform an annual AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) identifying risks and framework/control gaps to the attention of management and Group -Compliance. -Assist with periodical risk-based design and operating effectiveness testing of first-line AML/CFT controls, including on lower-risk clients. -Represent Compliance as needed on financial crime related projects and initiatives. -Assist in the resolution of Compliance-owned management action plans from audits, inspections and Group reviews. -Produce relevant management information reports to board and senior management on the governance of financial crime risks. -Build and maintain a proactive and constructive relationship with business and functional stakeholders to ensure appropriate controls are in place for financial crime risk identification and management. -Keep abreast and understand the impact of new financial crime regulations and where needed, represent the Bank in industry consultations. -Support the Singapore AML Lead on all AML/CFT matters and any other duties as assigned. Your profile -Bachelor Degree in law, banking or business. -Working knowledge of the CDSA, AML/CFT typologies, relevant MAS Regulations and Guidance on AML/CFT and the international sanctions framework. -Working experience of Singapore regulatory landscape and expectations needed. Familiarity with regulations and guidance in an AML, Financial crime Compliance role. -6-10 years of relevant experience in AML/CFT compliance particularly on investigations. -Prior experience in a similar role in a Private Bank will be advantageous. -Highly effective verbal and written communication and organizational skills. -Ability to multi-task competing priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail. -Capable of working with cross-functional and senior stakeholders. -Sense of accountability, good time management and ability to meet tight deadlines. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Your team Business Compliace Manager The successful candidate will join a team whose principal function is to analyse and perform control activities related to anti-money laundering (AML) and business risks. Your role The function will, amongst other tasks, assist the Chief Risk Officer & MLRO with:
• Promoting a strong compliance culture within the Bank.
• Reviewing new account applications for compliance with KYC requirements.
• Completing risk ratings of new accounts.
• Periodic reviews of existing customer accounts.
• Identification and review of unusual transactions.
• Review and analysis of name screening alerts.
• Reporting of key performamce indicators. Your profile
• Strong analytical skills.
• Ability to work independently and under pressure to meet strict deadlines.
• Must be a team player.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Excellent problem solving and organizational skills.
• Excellent research and analytical skills.
• Proficiency in a variety of software applications including Microsoft Office.
• At least five (5) years compliance or audit experience in a Private Bank or Trust Company.
• University degree (Banking, Finance, Law, Business Administration or a related field).
• Professional qualification (ICA International Compliance and Anti-Money Laundering Diplomas or ACAMS Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Certification).
• Experience in the preparation of information reports.
• In-depth knowledge of The Bank & Trust Companies Regulation Act, 2020. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. This function will join the Quality Control & Mobile team , reporting to the head of the team. In this role you will work on quality-control-related activities for the three teams (FA, TA and PETAL) and occasionally help the production teams during peak periods. Your role Mobile team
• Participate mainly for short support missions within the fund operational units to absorb operational overloads, identify process optimizations and support implementation of initiatives supporting operational efficiency.
• Identify areas of improvement in terms of the process and control framework, based on your experience in other teams and departments. The role of the function is to participate mainly for short support missions within the fund operational units to absorb operational overloads, identify process optimizations and support implementation of initiatives supporting operational efficiency. Quality Control
• Contribute to the implementation of key quality control deliverables such as KPIs developed with our BI platform (Tableau).
• Coordinate transversal reporting.
• Contribute to any other transversal project aimed at improving service delivery. Your profile Education:
• Master’s degree in Business administration or engineering (finance, IT, mathematics). Requested experience:
• 1 to 3 years’ experience in project management and change management, Process / data modelling, Fund operations or banking sector. Technical skills:
• Project Management skills.
• Data analysis and office tools skills (Excel, Tableau, PowerPoint, etc.). Soft skills:
• Organisational skills.
• Diligent in achieving objectives.
• Strong analytical and synthesis skills.
• Effective communication abilities and good interpersonal skills.
• Commitment-oriented mindset and a team spirit. Language skills:
• Fluent in French and English Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Your team 主にリテール公募投信を担当するプロダクトスペシャリストとして、受託者責任（fiduciary）および説明責任（accountability）を果たしつつ、ビジネスの拡大に貢献していただきます。 資産運用、運用商品および金融市場に関する専門知識を活かし、当社で提供する主にリテール公募投信のデ ューデリジェンス、運用報告、RFP対応、等を担当いただきます。 また、資産クラス横断または一部担当ファンドに関して、顧客向け投資情報に関する資料、投資環境説明用 資料、販売促進用資料、販売用資料等の作成ならびに提供を担当いただきます。 Your role
• 当社で提供する主にリテール公募投信の運用状況の把握、対外説明、運用報告書等のコメント作成
• 当社で提供する主にリテール公募投信の運用戦略、運用モニタリングおよびデューデリジェンス
• RFPや顧客からの質問への対応（RFPチームと協働）
• 社内各種プロジェクトへの参加・貢献
• 顧客向け投資情報に関する資料、投資環境説明用資料、販売促進用資料、販売用資料等の作成ならびに提供
• データチェック及びレポート類のWebサイトへのアップロード作業
• グローバルのピクテ・グループの資料の翻訳、チェック等（生成AI等の活用を想定） Your profile
• 金融業界（運用会社、証券会社等）における5年超の経験

• Prioritising and time management skills to address the volumes and urgent subjects

• Written and spoken fluency in French and English Personal qualities:
• Adaptive and transversal knowledge capability to be able to communicate (in written and orally) with Petal teams

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sua squadra La divisione delle Funzioni Corporate comprende le attività non bancarie del Gruppo e comprende oltre 600 dipendenti. Staffata da specialisti con una profonda conoscenza in tutti i settori commerciali, le funzioni centrali sono poste in vari dipartimenti del Gruppo: Comunicazione, Compliance, Finanza, Risorse Umane, Sicurezza dell'Informazione, Revisione Interna, Legale, Ufficio Corporativo, Rischio e Tassazione. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk and Taxation. The Financial Institutions Management (FIM) team, part of the Finance Department, is the Group's centre of expertise for managing relationships with financial institutions. As a key member of this team, you will help maintain and enhance the Group's vital relationships with our financial counterparties. Your role We are seeking a proactive and analytical professional to take ownership of optimising data management, streamlining workflows, and driving process automation across the team's activities. You will lead the transformation and implementation of these initiatives to ensure continuous improvement and innovation. You will be responsible for the following tasks: Process improvement and automation
• Analyse and map current processes, systems and tools across the team's activities.
• Identify inefficiencies and take the initiative to propose and implement improvements.
• Take ownership of automation solutions and drive the digital transformation of our workflows, leveraging advanced analytics and the latest technologies.
• Reduce reliance on manual processes and email-based requests by introducing robust, scalable solutions. Data Management and Quality
• Maintain and enhance financial counterparty master data (codification, static data).
• Lead efforts to build and manage a centralised “golden source” of data, ensuring high data quality and consistency.
• Implement and monitor automated data quality controls, ensuring data reconciliation and consistency across systems. Reporting and Monitoring
• Prepare impactful dashboards reports, and presentations for internal teams and senior management, using state-of-the-art data visualisation tools.
• Participate in projects that impact the team's activities, driving innovation, efficiency and the adoption of new data science methodologies. Your profile
• Master’s degree or equivalent.
• 3 to 5 years of experience and keen interest in banking, or previous experience in the banking industry.
• Experience in KYC/AML would be a plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and able to take initiative, structured, with strong attention to detail.
• Committed, results-driven and accountable.
• Strong team spirit with the ability to collaborate across teams and business lines.
• Keen interest in process improvement, automation and data visualisation, leveraging technology.
• Experience in SQL and Python.
• Experience with Business Intelligence Tools (Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau) and in Gen AI project implementation.
• Familiarity with data management concepts (data quality/governance).
• Fluent in French and English; other languages are a plus.
• Must be resident in Switzerland. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people. The Compliance function is responsible for helping Pictet’s senior management manage the compliance risks faced by Pictet. This role will focus on the risks faced by Pictet’s Singapore bank, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch. The AML/CFT Compliance Officer is part of the team that oversees the Bank’s financial crime framework, focused primarily on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance. The incumbent performs systematic AML/CFT reviews on high-risk clients before onboarding and subsequent periodic reviews, reviews alerts/issues escalated by first-line functions and reports suspicions of criminal or sanctioned activity, and provides advice on AML/CFT and sanctions management. . The officer monitors changes that may impact the business, working with business and support functions to ensure that the Bank complies with regulatory obligations and Group standards in the financial crime area. The role will report to the Compliance AML Lead. Your role Key responsibilities -Investigate relevant alerts and suspicious activities, and perform filing of STR to local authorities. -Perform ex-ante AML reviews on high-risk client onboarding and periodic reviews. -Review escalated alerts from first-line transaction monitoring, payment filtering and ongoing name screening controls. -Support external requests include production orders, due diligence queries and any relevant regulatory reporting (e.g. Remote Gambling Act reporting). -Act as an expert advisor to business and support functions on compliance and regulatory matters related to AML/CFT and international sanctions management. -Perform an annual AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) identifying risks and framework/control gaps to the attention of management and Group -Compliance. -Assist with periodical risk-based design and operating effectiveness testing of first-line AML/CFT controls, including on lower-risk clients. -Represent Compliance as needed on financial crime related projects and initiatives. -Assist in the resolution of Compliance-owned management action plans from audits, inspections and Group reviews. -Produce relevant management information reports to board and senior management on the governance of financial crime risks. -Build and maintain a proactive and constructive relationship with business and functional stakeholders to ensure appropriate controls are in place for financial crime risk identification and management. -Keep abreast and understand the impact of new financial crime regulations and where needed, represent the Bank in industry consultations. -Support the Singapore AML Lead on all AML/CFT matters and any other duties as assigned. Your profile -Bachelor Degree in law, banking or business. -Working knowledge of the CDSA, AML/CFT typologies, relevant MAS Regulations and Guidance on AML/CFT and the international sanctions framework. -Working experience of Singapore regulatory landscape and expectations needed. Familiarity with regulations and guidance in an AML, Financial crime Compliance role. -6-10 years of relevant experience in AML/CFT compliance particularly on investigations. -Prior experience in a similar role in a Private Bank will be advantageous. -Highly effective verbal and written communication and organizational skills. -Ability to multi-task competing priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail. -Capable of working with cross-functional and senior stakeholders. -Sense of accountability, good time management and ability to meet tight deadlines. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Your role The Taiwan Intermediary sales team is currently made up of professionals who prospect and service intermediary clients throughout Taiwan by marketing Pictet Asset Management’s (Pictet AM) strategies. Reporting to the Head of Sales - Taiwan, you will play a critical role in Pictet AM’s drive to further develop its business in Taiwan. Your responsibilities will be:
• Foster strong collaborative relationships with distributors and financial advisors to boost sales activities.
• Address and assist distributors' headquarters and clients in resolving product and market-related inquiries while nurturing relationships.
• Organize seminars and meetings to facilitate engagement and knowledge sharing.
• Actively participate in fund sales initiatives and strive to partner with distributors in campaigns to achieve the company's business goals and increase brand awareness.
• Regularly visit branches for fund promotion and training.
• Gather, organize, analyse, and share market intelligence related to distributors and industry peers.
• Contribute to the development of effective sales strategies based on market insights.
• Proactively carry out tasks assigned by the sales head, ensuring efficient and accurate completion of various assignments.
• Maintain various documents, including updating client contact information, preparing call reports, and documenting activity notes in Salesforce (SF). Your profile
• Hold a university degree or higher, with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in the financial industry.
• Have a deep understanding of various mutual fund products, such as equity, fixed-income, private equity and ETFs.
• Possess excellent interpersonal skills that foster effective teamwork and communication.
• Exhibit strong presentation skills to deliver persuasive sales pitches.
• Demonstrate problem-solving abilities and a strong sense of responsibility and commitment to the business. As the successful applicant you will show drive, have a keen entrepreneurial spirit and be able to develop successful business relationships and close deals. You will also have a flair for communication, be able to manage priorities and multi-task on different projects concurrently, as well as having an eye for detail. Working in a self-reliant manner in a broader team makes you excel. You will be joining a structured and highly motivated team. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. The Role is to provide 1st level support on Fund Admnistration activities. To centralise, coordinate, and respond to Clients, Business Lines & Auditors requests and contribute to improvements of the processes, procedures and operational platforms to guarantee the proper application of controls and consistently exceed client’s needs and expectations. Your role
• Collaborate with Business Implementation Team, Client Relationship Managers (CRM), Management Companies and other key stakeholders (Custody Bank, Pricing, Transfer Agent (TA)…) on Projects & fund-related events.
• Act as the main liaison for both external and internal Clients, as well as Auditors, regarding all Fund Administration day-to-day activities.
• Manage the end-to-end Audit process for the funds, from initial planning & timetable, preparation and coordination of the financial statements to final approval and CSSF filling. Respond to Audit queries and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions and / or process improvement & automation as needed.
• Support Fund Administration Operations teams and effectively manage relationships across various business lines, including CRM, Business Implementation Team, TA , Tax, and others.
• Demonstrate a proactive mindset in addressing fund-related issues, actively challenge the status quo, and contribute innovative ideas for process enhancement.
• Participate in due diligence meetings, service reviews, Client visits, and Board meetings as required.
• Monitor internal and external KPIs and take actions when needed
• Manage and resolve internal and external escalations, taking appropriate actions and escalating to management when necessary.
• Assist in the review of Operating Memorandum, Service Level Agreements, Prospectus, internal policies, procedures working instructions & check-list, RCSA Matrix and any other related documentation.
• Remain up to date with all internal policies and ensure strict adherence to legal and regulatory requirements.
• Act as back-up of Head of Client Services and participate in the Management Committee of the Funds Accounting Unit when required Your profile
• Strong knowledge of financial products and funds regulation.
• Master's degree in Economics or Finance
• Min 10 years experience in Accounting
• Fluent in French and English
• In-depth understanding of Fund Administration and the relationships with the different stakeholders
• Experience in NAV calculations and NAV production
• Strong experience in financial reporting and audit process
• Good knowledge in foreign currency hedging and asset pooling techniques.
• Experience in fund events (merger, CIK/RIK, fund restructuring, etc.).
• Knowledge of Multifonds.
• Good knowledge in MS Office tool (mainly Excel).
• Flexibility - Can-do attitude
• Client oriented mindset.
• Sense of initiative and willing to learn.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Strong communication & presentation skills
• Rigorous and organized.
• Manage Stress and prioritization. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment.
