descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Pictet Tech division specializes in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms, and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

The Technical Business Analyst acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and development teams, supporting the Funds Platform with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes. The role is responsible for understanding, analyzing, and translating business needs into effective technical solutions, ensuring the continuous improvement of business analysis practices and contributing to the overall success of the platform within the funds industry.

Your role

• Collaborate with business subject matter experts and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for the funds platform, with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes and operations.

• Translate business needs into clear, actionable IT requirements, user stories, and test scenarios using Agile methodologies and Jira.

• Propose and evaluate solution options in coordination with solution architects, considering existing systems, software, and market innovations (including AI).

• Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including specifications, process flows, and user guides.

• Lead project management activities as necessary, including stakeholder coordination, meeting facilitation, and milestone tracking.

• Conduct data analysis and support data-driven decision-making.

• Ensure the execution and delivery of IT projects in line with business requirements, timelines, and quality standards.

• Carry out functional acceptance testing, analyze production incidents, and support users during and after implementation.

• Contribute to process improvement initiatives by designing and implementing efficient workflows during system changes or migrations, focusing on innovation and optimization over replication of legacy processes

• Actively participate as a member of the Business Analyst Chapter; s hare knowledge, best practices, and drive the evolution of the business analysis discipline within the chapter

Your profile

• Min 5 years experience in a bank as Business Analyst

• Fluent in French and English

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst in the funds industry, with a strong focus on transfer agency processes.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to facilitate meetings and workshops.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a dynamic environment

• Project management experience, including organizing and leading cross-functional meetings.

• Fluent in English, French is an asset

• In-depth knowledge of transfer agency functions, including investor servicing, transaction processing, and related regulatory requirements.

• Experience with industry platforms and tools relevant to transfer agency (e.g., Multifonds TA, Fenergo); experience with system integrations and data migrations is a plus.

• Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and troubleshooting

• Experience working in Agile environments, with hands-on use of JIRA (and Confluence) for story management and project tracking.

• Ability to write clear, structured documentation and user stories.

• Familiarity with AI tools and their application in business analysis; experience implementing AI-driven solutions is a plus.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5200 people. La tua squadra Pictet Tech progetta, integra e gestisce applicazioni software che vanno dai sistemi di gestione del portafoglio e piattaforme di trading alle soluzioni bancarie e aziendali. La divisione è responsabile di alcune delle innovazioni chiave del Gruppo, sostenendo le operazioni aziendali. Il team Identity Management Platforms è dedicato alla gestione delle identità utente e della sicurezza in tutta l'organizzazione. Siamo responsabili per l'implementazione, l'automazione e la supervisione di soluzioni di autenticazione, autorizzazione e controllo accessi per tutte le applicazioni e le infrastrutture. La nostra missione è garantire l'accesso sicuro, senza soluzione di continuità e conforme a tutti gli utenti, migliorando continuamente i nostri processi e adottando le ultime tecnologie. Il tuo ruolo
• Progettazione, distribuzione e manutenzione di piattaforme e soluzioni IAM sia in ambienti cloud che ibridi.
• Automatizzare i processi di integrazione, distribuzione e gestione dell'identità/accesso utilizzando gli strumenti DevOps.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di sicurezza, infrastruttura e sviluppo per garantire la conformità e la sicurezza degli accessi.
• Contribuire alla definizione e all'attuazione delle politiche di sicurezza, audit e gestione degli accessi.
• Monitorare, diagnosticare e risolvere incidenti e problemi legati all'AM.
• Resta aggiornato sulle ultime tendenze e progressi nelle tecnologie IAM e DevOps Il tuo profilo
• Istruzione superiore in informatica o esperienza equivalente.
• Esperienza significativa nell'ingegneria DevOps con una comprensione approfondita dei Kubernetes e dell'orchestrazione dei container.
• Proficienza nelle pratiche di artigianato software, programmazione e progettazione API (Python, Java, Go, Bash o equivalente).
• Esperienza con sistemi Cloud come Azure o Amazon e configurazione di infrastruttura-as-code.
• Capacità di eseguire il debugging interfunzionale su entrambi i livelli di applicazione e infrastruttura.
• Comprensione completa dell'architettura del sistema e dei componenti della piattaforma.

Your team Pictet Tech designs, integrates and operates software applications ranging from portfolio management systems and trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while sustaining business operations. The Identity Management Platforms team is dedicated to managing user identities and security across the organisation. We are responsible for the implementation, automation and oversight of authentication, authorisation and access control solutions for all applications and infrastructure. Our mission is to ensure secure, seamless and compliant access for all users, while continuously improving our processes and adopting the latest technologies. Your role
• Design, deploy and maintain IAM platforms and solutions in both Cloud and hybrid environments.
• Automate integration, deployment and identity/access management processes using DevOps tools.
• Collaborate closely with security, infrastructure and development teams to ensure access compliance and security.
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of security, audit and access management policies.
• Monitor, diagnose and resolve IAM-related incidents and issues.
• Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in IAM and DevOps technologies Your profile
• Higher education in computer science or equivalent experience.
• Significant experience in DevOps engineering with in-depth understanding of Kubernetes and container orchestration.
• Proficiency in software craftsmanship practices, programming and API design (Python, Java, Go, Bash or equivalent).
• Experience with Cloud systems such as Azure or Amazon and infrastructure-as-code configuration.
• Ability to perform cross-functional debugging across both application and infrastructure layers.
• Comprehensive understanding of system architecture and platform components.
• Team spirit, autonomy, rigor and ability to work in an agile environment.
• Fluent in French and English.
• Swiss resident or willingness to relocate. Why join us?
• Work on innovative and strategic projects that are critical to the company’s security.
• Grow in a dynamic, technically challenging and ever-evolving environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. Your role The scope of the function is to oversee all the workflow from the trade reception, data analysis and life cycle data management to instruments pricing. The scope of asset includes listed products (equities, bonds, loan, derivatives), OTC products (IRS,CDS, FX & Equity options, TRS, CFD…) and Structured products (autocall, Reverse convertible, dual currency deposit, accumulator, Airbag…).
• Integration and control of assets opening in our global platform Neoxam.
• Control and publish prices, greeks, market data and analytics.
• Life cycle management of all Assets.
• Set up the necessary files to complement these feeds.
• Introduce the necessary settings for queries and Data/pricing flows for securities newly registered in our systems from our various financial information providers (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters and ICE).
• Regularly check and update these settings.
• Provide the assistance requested by the various users of these Data (accountants for investment funds, valuers, administrators, asset managers, wealth managers, etc.).
• Challenge of various assets type with the counterparty's prices.
• Liaise directly with our main stakeholders in case of issue. Your profile Requested experience:
• Master’s degree in Finance, economics.
• 2 to 5 years’ experience minimum in a similar position. Knowledge / technical skills:
• Good knowledge of financial products and good level in financial mathematic.
• Good knowledge of financial information providers.
• Skilled user of office software applications, especially Excel. Soft skills:
• Driven and capable of showing initiative in solving problems.
• An enquiring mind with strong learning skills and a well-developed critical faculty.
• Accuracy and thoroughness in searching for the information required to value securities.
• Good capacity to collaborate and find win-win solution. Language skills:
• French: fluent level
• English: good knowledge (written and spoken) Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. • Integration and control of assets opening in our global platform Neoxam.

Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centers worldwide, currently employing more than 5’000 people. The group is owned and managed by eight partners and stands out as a company with an entrepreneurial spirit and loyalty. Pictet has been present in Zurich since 1982 where it employs over 200 people. The Zurich branch is located at the Leuenhof, one of the most historic buildings on the prestigious Bahnhofstrasse. We are looking for a passionate Chef de Rang to join our team in Zurich. As a key member of our motivated team, you will be working for Food & Beverage activities, in our beautiful premises in the heart of Zurich. You will bring your communication skills, your ability to work independently and your good knowledge of foreign languages to a service-oriented team that will appreciate your motivation, high quality standards and networked thinking. Your organizational skills and thoughtful approach to your work will enable you to maintain an overview even in hectic situations. You will use your sense of responsibility, pleasant manner and outstanding client focus to support our own staff as well as our clients. Your role You will manage the activities of the restaurant dedicated to the Bank's clients and management, as well as external and internal events (banquets and catering). You will be the main contact for the kitchen and reception teams and coordinate and perform all the Food & Beverage activities. As a Food & Beverage Coordinator, you provide a first-class Food & Beverage service with an emphasis on quality and always maintain absolute discretion. Working hours are primarily during office hours, with only occasional evening shifts. Your responsibilities include the following:
• Plan and organize client lunches and hospitality service with or without external catering service
• Ensure the setting up of lounges or banquets according to the reservation forecasts and menus
• Take orders and propose food and wine pairings, if necessary
• Manage the wine cellar in coordination with Geneva’s F&B team
• Monitor the service and ensure its excellence
• Help to prepare client-facing events
• Ensure the maintenance of the material (silverware, glasses...), as well as its inventory
• Perform general administrative duties
• Participate in the establishment and improvement of standards and procedures Your profile
• Hotel management training/apprenticeship
• At least 5 years of experience in a high-end hospitality environment or in a successful running restaurant
• Native German speaker, fluent in English and knowledge of French would be an advantage
• Service-oriented, smart and confident appearance
• Must be resident in Switzerland Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. • Coordinate and execute regional marketing strategies and campaigns, including advertising, events, web, social media, and other marketing initiatives.
• Assist in the development and production of marketing collaterals, from information and data collection through to distribution, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines.

• Work closely with internal stakeholders, including local business teams, compliance, and headquarter marketing counterparts, to deliver marketing activities.
• Help maintain and update the firm’s web, digital, and social media platforms, ensuring content is accurate and engaging.
• Manage relationships with external vendors for the production of marketing assets, campaigns, events, and other communications materials.
• Track and report on marketing performance using analytics and KPIs, providing insights for ongoing improvement. Your profile
• University graduate in Marketing, Communications, or a relevant discipline.
• 5-10 years of solid marketing and communications experience in financial institutions is highly preferred.
• Strong attention to detail and creativity.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and desktop publishing tools.
• Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) in English and Chinese.
• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a diverse, multicultural environment.
• A proactive, results-oriented team player with a passion for marketing. Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. The Role is to provide 1st level support on Fund Admnistration activities. To centralise, coordinate, and respond to Clients, Business Lines & Auditors requests and contribute to improvements of the processes, procedures and operational platforms to guarantee the proper application of controls and consistently exceed client’s needs and expectations. Your role
• Collaborate with Business Implementation Team, Client Relationship Managers (CRM), Management Companies and other key stakeholders (Custody Bank, Pricing, Transfer Agent (TA)…) on Projects & fund-related events.
• Act as the main liaison for both external and internal Clients, as well as Auditors, regarding all Fund Administration day-to-day activities.
• Manage the end-to-end Audit process for the funds, from initial planning & timetable, preparation and coordination of the financial statements to final approval and CSSF filling. Respond to Audit queries and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions and / or process improvement & automation as needed.
• Support Fund Administration Operations teams and effectively manage relationships across various business lines, including CRM, Business Implementation Team, TA , Tax, and others.
• Demonstrate a proactive mindset in addressing fund-related issues, actively challenge the status quo, and contribute innovative ideas for process enhancement.
• Participate in due diligence meetings, service reviews, Client visits, and Board meetings as required.
• Monitor internal and external KPIs and take actions when needed
• Manage and resolve internal and external escalations, taking appropriate actions and escalating to management when necessary.
• Assist in the review of Operating Memorandum, Service Level Agreements, Prospectus, internal policies, procedures working instructions & check-list, RCSA Matrix and any other related documentation.
• Remain up to date with all internal policies and ensure strict adherence to legal and regulatory requirements.
• Act as back-up of Head of Client Services and participate in the Management Committee of the Funds Accounting Unit when required Your profile
• Strong knowledge of financial products and funds regulation.
• Master's degree in Economics or Finance
• Min 10 years experience in Accounting
• Fluent in French and English
• In-depth understanding of Fund Administration and the relationships with the different stakeholders
• Experience in NAV calculations and NAV production
• Strong experience in financial reporting and audit process
• Good knowledge in foreign currency hedging and asset pooling techniques.
• Experience in fund events (merger, CIK/RIK, fund restructuring, etc.).
• Knowledge of Multifonds.
• Good knowledge in MS Office tool (mainly Excel).
• Flexibility - Can-do attitude
• Client oriented mindset.
• Sense of initiative and willing to learn.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Strong communication & presentation skills
• Rigorous and organized.
• Manage Stress and prioritization. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. La tua squadra Pictet Alternative Advisors è uno specialista di investimento alternativo leader con competenze in fondi di copertura, private equity e immobiliare globale. Il team di Ginevra e Londra costruisce, gestisce e consiglia su portafogli di soluzioni di investimento alternative per clienti istituzionali e privati. Il Gruppo ha forti ambizioni di sviluppo per Pictet Alternative Advisors per i prossimi anni, in particolare per espandere la sua offerta di prodotti per includere ulteriori asset class e per sviluppare ulteriormente la sua base clienti istituzionale. In considerazione di questi sviluppi, Pictet Alternative Advisors sta cercando di assumere un Operations Officer per guidare il suo sviluppo. Con sede a Ginevra, si unirà a un team impegnato al centro di sostenere un forte livello di attività e crescita attraverso la nostra piattaforma di investimenti alternativi. Fornirai supporto operativo in una gamma diversificata di strategie di investimento, nonché conti gestiti. Il tuo ruolo
• Gestione e coordinamento delle operazioni connesse ai gruppi di investimento (Prodotti e mandati)
• Fornire supporto ai team di investimento, alla gestione e ai clienti interni.
• Monitoraggio dei calcoli NAV, FX hedging, reporting, transazioni e servizi client.
• Coordinamento con tutti i fornitori di servizi (legale, fiscale, conformità, amministratori, back-office, ecc.).
• Monitoraggio dei rischi e dei vincoli di investimento.
• Lavorare su vari progetti occasionali e ricorrenti (ad esempio calcoli TER).
• Ottimizzare e automatizzare i processi (sviluppo IT). Il tuo profilo
• Almeno cinque anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile in un dipartimento di fondi o con un responsabile patrimoniale.
• Prove conoscenze pratiche di prodotti alternativi (Hedge Funds, Private Equity, Real Estate) gestione delle operazioni.
• Rigoroso, con ottime capacità di numerazione e un'attenta attenzione ai dettagli.
• Una certa capacità di affrontare questioni / argomenti con specialisti di varie imprese (investment manager, tassa, conformità, ecc), con eccellenti capacità verbali e di scrittura in queste situazioni particolari.
• Avanzato utente di Excel e generalmente a proprio agio con nuovi sistemi IT. Idealmente con un interesse o un'esperienza AI.
• A suo agio esprimendosi sia in francese che in inglese, con la relativa competenza scritta a redigere documentazione e discutere questioni complesse con parti interne ed esterne, sia in madrelingua o meno.
• Deve essere residente in Svizzera o disposto a trasferirsi. Come il candidato scelto mostrerai energia ed entusiasmo nel tuo lavoro e sarai rigoroso nel tuo approccio. Sarete anche distinguersi a causa delle vostre eccellenti capacità di lavoro di squadra. Inoltre, sarete affidabili, in grado di mostrare discrezione e tenere a mente che gli interessi del cliente e l'eccellenza in ciò che si consegna è ciò che conta di più. Nota Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie Diversità e inclusione Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione sul posto di lavoro. Applicare Salva lavoro Email a un contatto Torna alla lista

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team Pictet Alternative Advisors is a leading alternative investment specialist with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. The Geneva- and London-based team constructs, manages and advises on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients. The Group has strong development ambitions for Pictet Alternative Advisors for the coming years, notably to expand its product offering to include additional asset classes and to further develop its institutional client base. In view of these developments, Pictet Alternative Advisors is looking to hire an Operations Officer to steer its development. Based in Geneva, you will be joining a busy team at the core of supporting a strong level of activity and growth across our alternative investments platform. You will provide operational support across a diversified range of investment strategies, as well as managed accounts. Your role
• Managing and coordinating operations linked to the investment teams (Products and mandates)
• Providing support for the investment teams, management and internal clients.
• Monitoring NAV calculations, FX hedging, reporting, transactions and client services.
• Coordinating with all service providers (legal, tax, compliance, administrators, back-office, etc.).
• Monitoring risks and investment constraints.
• Working on various occasional and recurrent projects (e.g. TER calculations).
• Optimising and automating processes (IT development). Your profile
• At least five years’ experience in a similar role in a fund department or with an asset manager.
• Proven practical knowledge of alternative products (Hedge Funds, Private Equity, Real Estate) operations management.
• Rigorous, with excellent numeracy skills and a keen attention to detail.
• A certain ability to deal with issues/topics with specialists from various businesses (investment managers, tax, compliance, etc.), with excellent verbal and writing skills in these particular situations.
• Advanced user of Excel and generally at ease with new IT systems. Ideally with an AI interest or experience.
• At ease expressing yourself in both French and English, with the relevant written proficiency to draft documentation and discuss complex matters with both internal and external parties, whether native speakers or not.
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate. As the chosen applicant you will show energy and enthusiasm in your work and be rigorous in your approach. You will also stand out owing to your excellent teamworking skills. Furthermore, you will be trustworthy, able to show discretion and keep in mind that client’s interests and excellence in what you deliver is what matters the most. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihr Team Pictet Alternative Advisors ist ein führender alternativer Investmentspezialist mit Know-how in Hedge-Fonds, Private Equity und Global Real Estate. Das Genfer und Londoner Team baut, verwaltet und berät Portfolios alternativer Investitionslösungen für institutionelle und private Kunden. Die Gruppe hat in den kommenden Jahren starke Entwicklungsambitionen für Pictet Alternative Advisors, insbesondere um ihr Produktangebot auf zusätzliche Assetklassen auszudehnen und seine institutionellen Kundenbasis weiter zu entwickeln. Angesichts dieser Entwicklungen sucht Pictet Alternative Advisors einen Operations Officer, um seine Entwicklung zu steuern. Mit Sitz in Genf stoßen Sie an einem geschäftigen Team, das ein starkes Maß an Aktivität und Wachstum auf unserer alternativen Investment-Plattform unterstützt. Sie werden operative Unterstützung über eine diversifizierte Palette von Anlagestrategien sowie verwaltete Konten bieten. Ihre Rolle
• Verwaltung und Koordination von Operationen im Zusammenhang mit den Investitionsteams (Produkte und Mandate)
• Unterstützung der Investitionsteams, des Managements und der internen Kunden.
• Überwachung von NAV-Berechnungen, FX-Hedging, Reporting, Transaktionen und Client-Services.
• Koordination mit allen Dienstleistern (Recht, Steuer, Compliance, Administratoren, Backoffice usw.).
• Überwachung von Risiken und Investitionsbeschränkungen.
• Arbeiten an verschiedenen gelegentlichen und wiederkehrenden Projekten (z.B. TER-Berechnungen).
• Optimierung und Automatisierung von Prozessen (IT-Entwicklung). Ihr Profil
• mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einer Fondsabteilung oder mit einem Asset Manager.
• Bewährtes praktisches Wissen über alternative Produkte (Hedge Funds, Private Equity, Real Estate) Betriebsmanagement.
• Rigorous, mit hervorragenden Zahlenfähigkeiten und eine scharfe Liebe zum Detail.
• Eine gewisse Fähigkeit, sich mit Fragen/Themen mit Spezialisten aus verschiedenen Unternehmen (Investment Manager, Steuer, Compliance, etc.) zu beschäftigen, mit exzellenten verbalen und schriftlichen Fähigkeiten in diesen besonderen Situationen.
• Erweiterter Benutzer von Excel und im Allgemeinen mit neuen IT-Systemen. Ideal mit einem KI Interesse oder Erfahrung.
• Leichte Ausdrücke in Französisch und Englisch, mit dem entsprechenden schriftlichen Abschluss, um Dokumente zu erstellen und komplexe Angelegenheiten mit internen und externen Parteien zu diskutieren, ob Muttersprachlern oder nicht.
• Muss in der Schweiz wohnhaft sein oder bereit sein, sich zu verlagern. Als gewählter Bewerber zeigen Sie Energie und Begeisterung in Ihrer Arbeit und sind streng in Ihrem Ansatz. Sie werden sich auch durch Ihre exzellenten Teamarbeitsfähigkeiten auszeichnen. Darüber hinaus werden Sie vertrauenswürdig sein, in der Lage sein, Diskretion zu zeigen und zu beachten, dass Kundeninteressen und Exzellenz in dem, was Sie liefern, ist, was am meisten wichtig ist. Anmerkung Wir werden keine Lebensläufe über Agenturen akzeptieren Vielfalt und Inklusion Pictet ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit und verpflichtet sich, eine vielfältige Umgebung zu schaffen. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre équipe Pictet Alternative Advisors est un spécialiste de l'investissement alternatif de premier plan avec une expertise en fonds spéculatifs, en fonds propres et en immobilier mondial. L'équipe basée à Genève et à Londres construit, gère et conseille des portefeuilles de solutions d'investissement alternatives pour les clients institutionnels et privés. Le Groupe a de fortes ambitions de développement pour Pictet Alternative Advisors pour les années à venir, notamment pour élargir son offre de produits afin d'inclure des classes d'actifs supplémentaires et pour développer sa clientèle institutionnelle. Compte tenu de ces développements, Pictet Alternative Advisors cherche à embaucher un agent des opérations pour diriger son développement. Basée à Genève, vous rejoindrez une équipe très occupée au cœur de la croissance et de l'activité de notre plateforme d'investissement alternative. Vous fournirez un soutien opérationnel dans un éventail diversifié de stratégies d'investissement, ainsi que des comptes gérés. Votre rôle
• Gestion et coordination des opérations liées aux équipes d'investissement (produits et mandats)
• Fournir un appui aux équipes d'investissement, à la direction et aux clients internes.
• Suivi des calculs de NAV, de la couverture FX, des rapports, des transactions et des services à la clientèle.
• Coordination avec tous les prestataires de services (juridique, fiscal, conformité, administrateurs, back-office, etc.).
• Suivi des risques et des contraintes d'investissement.
• Travail sur divers projets occasionnels et récurrents (par exemple calculs TER).
• Optimisation et automatisation des processus (développement des technologies de l'information). Votre profil
• Au moins cinq ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire dans un département de fonds ou avec un gestionnaire d'actifs.
• Connaissance pratique éprouvée de la gestion des opérations de produits alternatifs (fonds de couverture, fonds d'investissement privés, immobilier).
• Rigieuse, avec d'excellentes compétences en calcul et une attention particulière au détail.
• Une certaine capacité à traiter des questions/thèmes avec des spécialistes de diverses entreprises (gestionnaires d'investissements, fiscalité, conformité, etc.), avec d'excellentes compétences verbales et écrites dans ces situations particulières.
• Utilisateur avancé d'Excel et généralement à l'aise avec les nouveaux systèmes informatiques. Idéalement avec un intérêt ou une expérience d'IA.
• À l'aise de s'exprimer en français et en anglais, avec la compétence écrite nécessaire pour rédiger la documentation et discuter de questions complexes avec les parties internes et externes, qu'elles soient ou non de langue maternelle.
• Doit résider en Suisse ou vouloir déménager. En tant que candidat choisi, vous ferez preuve d'énergie et d'enthousiasme dans votre travail et serez rigoureux dans votre approche. Vous vous démarquerez également en raison de vos excellentes compétences en travail d'équipe. De plus, vous serez digne de confiance, capable de faire preuve de discrétion et garder à l'esprit que les intérêts et l'excellence du client dans ce que vous livrez est ce qui compte le plus. Remarque Nous n'accepterons aucun CV par l'intermédiaire des agences Diversité et inclusion Pictet est un employeur à chances égales et s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Nous respectons toutes les personnes et nous cherchons à les inclure dans le milieu de travail. Appliquer Enregistrer l'emploi Courriel à un contact Retour à la liste

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. You will be a member of the Quality Control & Mobile team , reporting to the head of the team. In this role you will work on quality-control-related activities for the three teams ( Fund Accounting, Transfer Agency and Private Equity ) and occasionally provide support to the production teams during peak periods. Your role You will assist our Quality Control & Mobile team for the fund operations processes :
• Providing support operational teams in their daily tasks,
• Identifying areas of improvement in terms of the process and control framework,
• Contributing to the implementation of key quality control deliverables such as KPIs and the procedure framework review,
• Contributing to any other transversal project aimed at improving service delivery. Your profile Qualifications and experience:
• Pursuing a university degree in Finance, Economics or a related field. Specific knowledge:
• Knowledge in fund operations,
• Experience in process and data analysis,
• Project management and organizational skills,
• Good Excel and PowerPoint skills. Language skills:
• Spoken fluency in English and French. Personal qualities:
• Flexibility and agility,
• Strong interpersonal skills that enable effective communication and collaboration with colleagues and clients. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

• 顧客への運用ソリューションの提案
• 担当プロダクトの顧客向け説明およびビジネスデベロップメント活動（営業部門との協働）

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra

A Pictet, le nostre divisioni Technology and Operations lavorano in stretta collaborazione per fornire soluzioni innovative, sicure ed efficienti che spingono il successo del Gruppo. La divisione Technology sviluppa e integra soluzioni software avanzate, come sistemi di gestione del portafoglio, piattaforme di trading e applicazioni bancarie, giocando un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione digitale del Gruppo e nella creazione del valore del cliente. La divisione Operazioni garantisce il trattamento sicuro ed efficiente delle transazioni bancarie e dei fondi di investimento, mantenendo la conformità normativa e la gestione dei rischi operativi per supportare l'affidabilità dei nostri servizi finanziari.

Insieme, la tecnologia e le operazioni costituiscono la spina dorsale della capacità di Pictet di offrire esperienze client eccezionali, svolgendo un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione digitale del Gruppo e nella creazione di valore.

Sarai parte del team Finance Pictet Tech & Operations. Il team svolge un ruolo fondamentale nello sterzo finanziario della divisione, fornendo dati finanziari tempestivi e rilevanti e report nell'allineamento delle strategie finanziarie con gli obiettivi aziendali e fornendo informazioni attuabili agli stakeholder.

Il tuo ruolo

Come membro del team Finance Tech & Operations, possiederai lo sviluppo di dashboard finanziari, gestirai modelli di dati analitici finanziari, automatizza i processi di produzione di report e agirai come principale collegamento di finanza con il team Central Data Engineering. Contribuirai sia alla continuità operativa dei processi finanziari sia alla trasformazione a più lungo termine dell'analisi delle finanze all'interno della Pictet Technology and Operations.

• Assicurare la coerenza e l'integrità dei dati attraverso gli strati di reporting di finanza e le pipeline di dati a monte.
• Sviluppare e gestire il modello di dati analitici finanziari, assicurando che riflette con precisione le ultime opinioni analitiche.
• Guidare l'automazione dei processi di produzione e reporting dei dati finanziari, eliminando i flussi di lavoro manuali e migliorando l'affidabilità e la frequenza dei report finanziari.
• Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di cruscotti finanziari che coprono P&L per prodotto, allocazione dei costi e KPI operativi allineati con nuovo modello operativo.
• Supporto FP&A e attività di gestione contabile con analisi robuste e scalabili.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea magistrale in informatica, scienza dei dati, ingegneria o un campo correlato.
• 3-5 anni di esperienza come analista di dati – esperienza di collaborazione con i team finanziari è un vantaggio.
• Forte competenza in SQL, pitone e esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione.
• Eccellente capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con un'attenta attenzione ai dettagli.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di collegare gli stakeholder tecnici (Data Engineering) e aziendali (Finance).
• Automotivato, proattivo e in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente.
• Volontà di imparare e adattarsi a nuove tecnologie e strumenti.
• Residente in Svizzera o disposto a trasferirsi.

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie.

Ref.: FDA/CC/ FAA

Your team

At Pictet, our Technology and Operations divisions work in close partnership to deliver innovative, secure, and efficient solutions that drive the Group’s success. The Technology division develops and integrates advanced software solutions, such as portfolio management systems, trading platforms, and banking applications – playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and client value creation. The Operations division ensures the secure and efficient processing of banking transactions and investment funds, maintaining regulatory compliance and managing operational risks to support the reliability of our financial services.

Together, Technology and Operations form the backbone of Pictet’s ability to deliver outstanding client experiences, playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and value creation.

You will be part of the Finance Pictet Tech & Operations team. The team plays a pivotal role in the financial steering of the division, by providing timely, relevant financial data and reports in aligning financial strategies with business objectives and delivering actionable insights to stakeholders.

Your role

As a member of the Finance Tech & Operations team, you will own the development of financial dashboards, manage finance analytical data models, automate reporting production processes, and act as the primary Finance liaison with the Central Data Engineering team. You will contribute to both the operational continuity of financial processes and the longer-term transformation of Finance analytics within Pictet Technology and Operations.

• Ensure data consistency and integrity across finance reporting layers and upstream data pipelines.
• Develop and manage the finance analytical data model, ensuring it accurately reflects latest analytical views.
• Drive the automation of finance data production and reporting processes, eliminating manual workflows and enhancing the reliability and frequency of financial reporting.
• Design, build, and maintain financial dashboards covering P&L by product, cost allocation, and operational KPIs aligned with new operating model.
• Support FP&A and management accounting activities with robust, scalable analytics.

Your profile

• Master’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field.
• 3-5 years of experience as a data analyst – experience collaborating with finance teams is a plus.
• Strong proficiency in SQL, python, and experience with visualisation tools.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical (Data Engineering) and business (Finance) stakeholders.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.
• Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.
• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref. : FDA/CC/FAA

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Ihr Team

Unsere Divisionen Technologie und Operations arbeiten bei Pictet in enger Partnerschaft, um innovative, sichere und effiziente Lösungen zu schaffen, die den Erfolg des Konzerns vorantreiben. Der Bereich Technologie entwickelt und integriert fortschrittliche Softwarelösungen, wie Portfoliomanagement-Systeme, Handelsplattformen und Banking-Anwendungen – eine Schlüsselrolle in der digitalen Transformation und der Wertschöpfung der Gruppe. Der Geschäftsbereich Operationen gewährleistet die sichere und effiziente Abwicklung von Bankgeschäften und Investmentfonds, die Einhaltung regulatorischer Compliance und das Management operativer Risiken zur Unterstützung der Zuverlässigkeit unserer Finanzdienstleistungen.

Gemeinsam bilden Technologie und Operationen das Rückgrat von Pictets Fähigkeit, herausragende Kundenerfahrungen zu liefern, eine Schlüsselrolle in der digitalen Transformation und Wertschöpfung der Gruppe zu spielen.

Sie werden Teil des Finance Pictet Tech & Operations Teams sein. Das Team spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Finanzlenkung der Division, indem es zeitnahe, relevante Finanzdaten und Berichte zur Ausrichtung von Finanzstrategien mit Geschäftszielen und zur Bereitstellung von handlungsfähigen Erkenntnissen an Interessenvertreter gibt.

Ihre Rolle

Als Mitglied des Finance Tech & Operations Teams besitzen Sie die Entwicklung von Finanz-Dashboards, verwalten Finanzanalysedatenmodelle, automatisieren Reporting-Produktionsprozesse und fungieren als primäre Finanz-Verbindung mit dem Central Data Engineering Team. Sie werden sowohl zur operativen Kontinuität von Finanzprozessen als auch zur langfristigen Transformation von Finanzanalysen in Pictet Technology und Operations beitragen.

• Gewährleistung der Datenkonsistenz und -integrität über Finanzberichte und vorgelagerte Datenpipelines.
• Entwicklung und Verwaltung des Finanzanalytischen Datenmodells, um sicherzustellen, dass es die neuesten analytischen Ansichten genau widerspiegelt.
• Die Automatisierung von Finanzdatenproduktions- und Berichtsprozessen, die Beseitigung manueller Workflows und die Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit und Häufigkeit der Finanzberichterstattung.
• Konzipieren, bauen und pflegen finanzielle Dashboards, die P&L nach Produkt, Kostenzuweisung und operativen Kennzahlen abdecken, die mit dem neuen Betriebsmodell übereinstimmen.
• Unterstützung von FP&A- und Management-Buchungsaktivitäten mit robusten, skalierbaren Analysen.

Ihr Profil

• Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Datenwissenschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung als Data Analyst – Erfahrung in Zusammenarbeit mit Finanzteams ist ein Plus.
• Starke Kenntnisse in SQL, Python und Erfahrung mit Visualisierungstools.
• Ausgezeichnete analytische und Problemlösung Fähigkeiten, mit viel Liebe zum Detail.
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, technische (Data Engineering) und Business (Finance) Stakeholder zu überbrücken.
• Selbstmotiviert, proaktiv und selbständig arbeiten können.
• Bereitschaft, neue Technologien und Werkzeuge zu lernen und anzupassen.
• Wohnsitz in der Schweiz oder bereit, sich zu verlagern.

Anmerkung

Wir werden keine Lebensläufe über Agenturen akzeptieren.

Ref.: FDA/CC/ FAO

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience. The role of the function is to ensure the smooth running of the publishing production according to the SLAs, deadlines and roadmaps in place for in-house and third-party funds. A high level of client support (internal and external) will be expected. Your role
• Code request as part of fund launch process (LEI, Bloomberg Tickers, etc…).
• Set up, control / update of static and dynamic data.
• Contribute to the efficient and accurate execution of publishing operations.
• Activate and publish request according to registration status.
• Disseminate legal fund documentations, monthly portfolio reports and No NAV calculation reports.
• Manage the chargeback of invoices.
• Collect and organize documents.
• Scan and archive documents and data. Your profile Knowledge /Technical skills:
• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related
• 2-year experience in banking sector
• Good knowledge in fund operations, process and data analysis
• In-depth knowledge of MS Office and banking softwares (Multifonds, Luxis and Avaloq)
• Excellent knowledge of operational banking and legal perspective for funds
• Good knowledge in Python programming and being at ease with the use of AI Tools would be considered as distinguishing factors. Soft skills:
• Rigor
• Attention to detail
• Organizational skills
• Team spirit
• Problem solving abilities Language skills
• Fluent in french and english Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people.

Your role

Pictet is seeking to recruit a Marketing Manager (1-Year Contract) to work in the Marketing Asia - HKG team to support and coordinate marketing activities for Pictet Asset Management in Asia excluding Japan, contributing to brand visibility and business development in the region.

• Coordinate and execute regional marketing strategies and campaigns, including advertising, events, web, social media, and other marketing initiatives.

• Assist in the development and production of marketing collaterals, from information and data collection through to distribution, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines.

• Monitor the publication of global marketing content and support local content production and translation, liaising with external service providers as needed.

• Demonstrate creativity in developing innovative marketing campaigns and designing thoughtful client gifts that are highly valued and appreciated by recipients.

• Work closely with internal stakeholders, including local business teams, compliance, and headquarter marketing counterparts, to deliver marketing activities.

• Help maintain and update the firm’s web, digital, and social media platforms, ensuring content is accurate and engaging.

• Manage relationships with external vendors for the production of marketing assets, campaigns, events, and other communications materials.

• Track and report on marketing performance using analytics and KPIs, providing insights for ongoing improvement.

Your profile

• University graduate in Marketing, Communications, or a relevant discipline.

• 5-10 years of solid marketing and communications experience in financial institutions is highly preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and creativity.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and desktop publishing tools.

• Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) in English and Chinese.

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a diverse, multicultural environment.

• A proactive, results-oriented team player with a passion for marketing.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Votre équipe Pictet Asset Services (PAS) propose des services de banque dépositaire, des services liés aux fonds ainsi que des solutions de trading à des gérants indépendants, à des gestionnaires de fonds et à des clients institutionnels. Nous maîtrisons en interne chaque dimension de l’asset servicing et concevons des solutions sur mesure, telles que des outils analytiques à valeur ajoutée, des supports à l’élaboration de stratégies de trading et des interfaces utilisateurs, pour offrir une expérience client inégalée. Votre rôle - Etre le contact principal pour un portefeuille de gérants indépendants (GI). - Offrir un support et résoudre les problèmes pour toutes les thématiques opérationnelles et administratives. - Participer au processus administratif de mise en place des relations GI et de leurs comptes clients, en collaboration avec les chargés de relations (CRM). - Traiter les opérations de paiement et de transfert, en veillant à ce que les appels de vérification (call-back) soient effectués de manière systématique, et fournir un soutien pour les autres types de transactions, selon les besoins. - Traiter les demandes (codifications clients internes, cartes de crédit, limites de crédit, conditions spéciales, etc.) et effectuer les saisies dans les workflows correspondants. - Gérer le flux documentaire (archivage, traitement des formulaires physiques et électroniques). - Bien connaître les principaux partenaires internes, établir avec eux d’étroites relations et être leur interlocuteur/trice de référence pour le portefeuille. - Veiller à ce que la prise des appels téléphoniques soit assurée au sein de l’équipe et fournir un soutien pour les tâches administratives. - Appliquer les politiques et directives en vigueur et accompagner la mise en œuvre de nouvelles règles. Votre profil - Formation bancaire ou jugée équivalente. - Expérience de 5 ans dans le support aux GI. - Excellentes connaissances transversales au niveau des flux opérationnels. - Sens du service à la clientèle. - Solide esprit d’équipe. - Aptitude à communiquer avec une grande aisance. - Sens développé des responsabilités, résistance au stress et capacité à gérer des situations délicates. - Sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités. - Très bonne connaissance des outils informatiques usuels MS Office/Avaloq. - Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral. - Domicile en Suisse requis. Note CRO/FH/AA We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment specialist and wholly owned subsidiary of the Pictet Group, with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. With teams based around the world, the PAA teams construct, manage and advise on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients. The Group has strong growth ambitions for PAA for the years ahead, notably to expand its product offering to include additional asset classes and to further develop its institutional client base. Based in Geneva, you will become part of a dynamic five-person team on a six-month temporary contract, assisting with a rise in workload and activity. Your role will involve offering operational support for both hedge fund portfolios and managed accounts. Your role
• Managing and coordinating operations linked to PAA’s hedge fund products and mandates (NAV calculations, reporting, transactions and client services).
• Providing support to the investment teams, management and internal clients.
• Coordinating with all service providers (legal, tax, compliance, administrators, back office, etc.).
• Monitoring risks and investment constraints.
• Working on various occasional and recurrent projects (e.g. TER calculations). Your profile
• At least five years’ experience in a similar role in a fund department or with an asset manager.
• Proven practical knowledge of hedge fund operations management.
• Rigorous, with excellent numeracy skills and a keen attention to detail.
• A certain ability to deal with issues/topics with specialists from various businesses (investment managers, tax, compliance, etc.), with excellent verbal and writing skills in these particular situations.
• Advanced user of Excel and generally at ease with new IT systems. Use of Webfolio is a plus.
• At ease expressing yourself in both French and English, with the relevant written proficiency to draft documentation and discuss complex matters with both internal and external parties, whether native speakers or not.
• A strong interest in and/or experience with AI would be an asset.
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Your team Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment specialist and wholly owned subsidiary of the Pictet Group, with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. With teams based around the world, the PAA teams construct, manage and advise on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients. The Group has strong growth ambitions for PAA for the years ahead, notably to expand its product offering to include additional asset classes and to further develop its institutional client base. Based in Geneva, you will become part of a dynamic five-person team on a six-month temporary contract, assisting with a rise in workload and activity. Your role will involve offering operational support for both hedge fund portfolios and managed accounts. Your role
• Managing and coordinating operations linked to PAA’s hedge fund products and mandates (NAV calculations, reporting, transactions and client services).
• Providing support to the investment teams, management and internal clients.
• Coordinating with all service providers (legal, tax, compliance, administrators, back office, etc.).
• Monitoring risks and investment constraints.
• Working on various occasional and recurrent projects (e.g. TER calculations). Your profile
• At least five years’ experience in a similar role in a fund department or with an asset manager.
• Proven practical knowledge of hedge fund operations management.
• Rigorous, with excellent numeracy skills and a keen attention to detail.
• A certain ability to deal with issues/topics with specialists from various businesses (investment managers, tax, compliance, etc.), with excellent verbal and writing skills in these particular situations.
• Advanced user of Excel and generally at ease with new IT systems. Use of Webfolio is a plus.
• At ease expressing yourself in both French and English, with the relevant written proficiency to draft documentation and discuss complex matters with both internal and external parties, whether native speakers or not.
• A strong interest in and/or experience with AI would be an asset.
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate. Your team The Pictet Group is a leading independent wealth and asset management firm operating globally. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group maintains operations in 30 offices across key financial centers worldwide, employing more than 4,600 professionals. Pictet has been present in Singapore for over 30 years, supported by a team exceeding 200 employees. Your role
• Client Management o Prepare relevant files and account reports for relevant parties prior to meeting with clients. o Respond to client queries and attend to issues and requests. o Assist with the administrative support of clients’ relationships, and liaise with all other Departments when required (operational, administration, investment, legal etc.). o Ensure client's records / accounts / investments / market information are current and information updates are timely maintained with relevant accompanying correspondences and meeting reports.
• Business Development o Keep the CEO advised of time-sensitive and high-priority issues, ensuring appropriate follow up. o Liaise with head office for any administrative issues. o Assist in composing replies for CEO’s review and approval as and when required. o Ensure fit-and-proper requirements are met (e.g. CPD requirements, complete mandatory training etc.) as stipulated by the regulators.
• Provide strong coordination support across respective Investment Teams within the Bank
• Liaison for Stakeholder teams o Interface for Risk, Marketing, Compliance, Business Heads, Management Teams, etc both internal and external stakeholders o Serve as a liaison between CEO, Management Team, internal and external stakeholders.
• Operational Support o Ensure necessary follow-up actions are promptly taken on various operational matters e.g. deficiency and outstanding documentation. o Provide efficient day-to-day support (including email inbox management, co-ordination, and other ad hoc tasks). o Maintain the CEO’s calendar, including scheduling meetings, appointments, business travel arrangements. o Schedule and organize departmental meetings; assist in the preparation and distribution of meeting agendas and materials. Your profile
• University degree or equivalent, preferably in Business Management, Economics or Finance.
• Strong understanding of local and regional regulatory climate
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with the highest professional work ethic and standards.
• Exercises discretion and maintains confidentiality and sensitivity of matters.
• Strong sense of initiative and resourcefulness to resolve issues as responsibilities and challenges vary.
• Excellent interpersonal, communication and client interfacing skills.
• Strong understanding of financial products and services.
• First class presentation and communication skills
• Familiar with AML and compliance requirements within the Private Banking space. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

• Monitor orders for UCI share subscriptions/redemptions, transfers and conversions.

• Prepare and send out confirmations and reports to promoters, distributors and other fund intermediaries.

• Respond rapidly to different requests from clients (inside and outside the Group) to guarantee that a quality service is provided that meets the requirements of a demanding client.

• Manage client commissions and dividends for in-house and third-party funds.

• Manage events on Funds (in kind transfers, launches, liquidations…).

• Work on automating various configurations within the tool “Multifonds Global Investor”, primarily focusing on Fund setup, by implementing key controls.

• Play a coordinating role in fund-related events across teams, including fund launches, compartments, classes, mergers, and liquidations.

• Review Fund’s prospectuses to ensure alignment between promoter requests and system feasibility.

• Offer technical and functional support to other teams within the service.

Your profile

• Extensive knowledge of the Transfer Agent business and all-round understanding of fund administration processes

• Unversity degree in Economics or Finance

• 5 years' experience in similar position

• Fluent in french and english

• Excellent knowledge of the “MFGI - Multifonds Global Investor” tool and proven experience in its usage.

• Extensive knowledge of the Office suite.

• SQL knowledge is a must have.

• Flexibility

• Ability to handle stress.

• Rigor in checking, sending, confirming and monitoring orders.

• Enthusiasm and drive and ability to show initiative in solving problems.

• Enquiring mind and ability to learn quickly.

• Team player.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

• Actively participate in client data remediation plan within the bank’s secure environment, specifically in the client repository.

• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field.
• Meticulous, detail-oriented, and organized, delivering work of the highest quality.
• Dynamic, proactive in problem-solving, and demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit.
• Able to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.
• Proficient in standard MS Office products.
• Interest in automation, digitalization, and new technologies, with the ability to design, maintain, or improve automated operational tools (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, AI agents, etc.), while adhering to security and compliance standards is a strong asset.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Votre équipe FundPartner Solutions propose une gamme complète de services d’administration de fonds et de création de fonds sur mesure. Ses équipes de spécialistes apportent leurs compétences en matière de domiciliation, d’enregistrement et de gouvernance de fonds, ainsi que de gestion des risques et de contrôle du respect des directives de placement. En tant que Business Compliance & Operations Liaison Officer vous serez responsable de la gestion et de la coordination des projets entre les diverses équipes de la société ainsi qu’avec les prestataires externes de type gestionnaires de fortune collective. Vous assurerez un support opérationnel de qualité, coordonnerez les flux d’information et veillerez à la conformité des processus liés à l’administration et à la gouvernance des fonds d’investissement de droit suisse. Ce rôle est essentiel pour garantir une efficience optimale et le respect des exigences réglementaires lors de la mise en place et du suivi de fonds d’investissements. Votre rôle
• Agir comme point de contact principal pour les équipes internes (juridique, compliance, risques, administration fonds) sur les aspects opérationnels et administratifs.
• Gérer la coordination légale et opérationnelle des projets liés à la mise en place de nouveaux fonds ou mandats de gestion, en collaboration avec les départements internes et externes (gérants, autorité, audit, etc).
• Coordonner et suivre les projets clients, en veillant à la collecte des documents, au respect des délais et à la bonne communication entre les parties prenantes pour assurer leur mise en œuvre.
• Assurer la mise à jour, la gestion et la publication des données des fonds de placement dans les systèmes internes, ainsi que la production de rapports réglementaires et opérationnels.
• Gérer la coordination et la préparation administrative des demandes provenant de diverses autorités (FINMA, AFC, etc) ainsi que des demandes d’audit interne et externe participer aux activités et tâches liées à la gouvernance d’entreprise.
• Soutenir opérationnellement les équipes dans le suivi et l’implémentation des documents et des contrats de la société et participer au processus clé de vérification nécessaires pour les divers processus de la société.
• Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus, à l’optimisation des outils de travail et à la préparation de documents pour les clients et comités internes. Votre profil
• Solide expérience (5-10 ans) dans le secteur bancaire ou financier, avec formation supérieure (Bachelor ou équivalent).
• Bonne connaissance des produits financiers et des processus opérationnels en environnement financier.
• Maîtrise des réglementations suisses et internationales, avec curiosité et capacité à en comprendre les enjeux.
• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais (l’allemand est un atout), avec de bonnes compétences en communication.
• Maîtrise des outils MS Office et sens de l’organisation pour gérer plusieurs tâches en parallèle.
• Esprit d’équipe, orientation client, rigueur, autonomie et capacité à résoudre des problèmes.
• Domicile en Suisse requis. Note BCLO/FH/IM We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

• Agir comme point de contact principal pour les équipes internes (juridique, compliance, risques, administration fonds) sur les aspects opérationnels et administratifs.
• Gérer la coordination légale et opérationnelle des projets liés à la mise en place de nouveaux fonds ou mandats de gestion, en collaboration avec les départements internes et externes (gérants, autorité, audit, etc).
• Coordonner et suivre les projets clients, en veillant à la collecte des documents, au respect des délais et à la bonne communication entre les parties prenantes pour assurer leur mise en œuvre.
• Assurer la mise à jour, la gestion et la publication des données des fonds de placement dans les systèmes internes, ainsi que la production de rapports réglementaires et opérationnels.

• Solide expérience (5-10 ans) dans le secteur bancaire ou financier, avec formation supérieure (Bachelor ou équivalent).

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience. As an intern within the Pictet Asset Services department, you will support the Client Relationship Management (CRO/CRM) teams in their daily activities. This internship will allow you to develop operational, regulatory, and interpersonal skills while contributing to the quality of client service.
• Start date: August/September
• Duration: 12 months
• Employment rate: part-time
• Prerequisite: a tripartite internship agreement signed with your school Your role
• Provide daily operational support to the teams in managing client files: preparation, verification, and follow-up of documents required for account opening, modification, or closure.
• Assist in the management of routine operations: signature verification, execution and monitoring of transactions (orders, payments, fund and asset transfers), management of incoming/outgoing flows, coordination with counterparties, and alerting in case of blockages.
• Participate in the preparation and updating of client files, ensuring information compliance and completeness of supporting documents.
• Support the teams in handling client requests, processing queries, and resolving simple incidents, ensuring rigorous follow-up and effective communication.
• Contribute to verifying the accuracy of transactions and the quality of data entered into internal tools.
• Act as a point of contact for administrative and logistical tasks related to client relationship management. Your profile Qualifications and experience:
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration or Economics.
• First experience (internship) in a client relationship management role within the financial services industry, idealy in private banking or wealth management Personal qualities:
• Attention to detail and organizational skills
• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
• Strong interpersonal skills and a team-oriented mindset
• Proactive and solution-oriented approach Language Skills:
• French: fluent level
• English: good knowledge (written and spoken) Note Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 27 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5300 people. Pictet has been present in London since 1990, and employs approximately 400 people. Pictet Asset Management (PAM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service. The PAM London HR team includes Generalist, Learning & Development and Reward & Benefits specialisms. Together, we partner with the business to provide comprehensive and high-touch support to approximately 300 PAM employees as well as delivering local HR support to colleagues in Pictet Wealth Management and Pictet Alternative Advisors. Your role Reporting to the Senior HR Business Partner, you will act as a trusted partner to defined client groups across PAM‘s enabling functions where you will be responsible for leading on all people related topics. This includes: › Recruitment: Collaborate with managers to understand hiring rationale, shape & execute the recruitment strategy including influencing job descriptions, sourcing strategy and interview structure as well as sharing insightful interview feedback. Support the hiring decision process and design offers with input from the Reward team. › Compensation & Benefits: Support managers through a seamless annual compensation review cycle, sharing input on salary reviews and bonus decisions. Act as the first point of contact for benefits related questions, calling on the guidance of the Reward team where needed. › Performance Management: Work closely with managers to ensure effective performance management practises are in place including objective setting, mid-years, and appraisals whilst fostering a culture of ongoing feedback. › Employee Relations: Serve as a trusted advisor on employee relations matters providing guidance on performance management practises, conflict resolution and disciplinary actions for example. › Talent Management: Guide managers through succession planning and talent mapping, supporting client groups to build a strong, skills focused talent pipeline. Support employees in their own development which may include advising on internal mobility, secondment opportunities etc. › Organisational Design & Employee Engagement : Provide advice on organisational design & structure and champion employee engagement initiatives to foster a culture of high performance and engagement. › Ensure all operational & life-cycle processes for dedicated client area run smoothly and effectively. For example, responsible for executing new joiner onboarding, amendments, leavers processes etc. › Support the broader Generalist HR team on regulatory change, process improvements, and policy updates. Your profile › At least five years’ HR experience in a fast-paced high-performance environment delivering the best possible outcomes for the business. › Sound knowledge of UK employment laws, employee relations, and regulations and the ability to apply them in live business scenarios. › Proven ability to manage stakeholders, influence, and navigate multiple priorities. › Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build credible relationships across the business. › Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to manage complex and sensitive employee relations matters. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. HRBP/RF/CB Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Pictet has been present in London since 1990, and employs approximately 400 people. Pictet Asset Management (PAM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients.
