Your role Reporting to the Senior HR BP and working alongside two other HR generalists, you will become a trusted first point of contact and advisor to all colleagues in London across a range of HR generalist topics. › Recruitment : In collaboration with HR BPs, execute the recruit-ment strategy including drafting job descriptions, manage external recruitment support, organise interviews and issue contracts. In time, lead recruitment processes end to end with an initial focus on temporary roles. › Onboarding : Accompany new joiners from the point of signature to their first day in a seamless onboarding journey using SuccessFactors modules. Ownership of content & delivery of new joiner inductions, benefits briefings etc. Key liaison with IT, Compliance etc to ensure new joiner’s have full set-up from day one. › Benefits : Act as the first point of contact for benefits related questions, calling on the guidance of the Reward team where needed. › Ensure all operational & life-cycle processes run smoothly and effectively. For example, amendment letters, departure processes, background screenings, reference requests etc. › Employee Relations : Support HR BPs where needed or when a learning opportunity is available. For example, note taking during disciplinary, grievances or sickness absence processes. › Support the broader Generalist HR team on regulatory change, process improvements, and policy updates. Your profile › Approximately 1 years’ experience in a fast-paced high-performance environment delivering the best possible outcomes for the business. This could be within a HR, Recruitment, or Team Assistant role. › Experience using SuccessFactors, Icertis, and Docusign alongside an automation mindset are advantageous. › Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build credible relationships across the business. › Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. HRO/RF/CB Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. Act as the first point of contact for benefits related questions, calling on the guidance of the Reward team where needed. › Performance Management: Work closely with managers to ensure effective performance management practises are in place including objective setting, mid-years, and appraisals whilst fostering a culture of ongoing feedback. › Employee Relations: Serve as a trusted advisor on employee relations matters providing guidance on performance management practises, conflict resolution and disciplinary actions for example. › Talent Management: Guide managers through succession planning and talent mapping, supporting client groups to build a strong, skills focused talent pipeline. Support employees in their own development which may include advising on internal mobility, secondment opportunities etc. › Organisational Design & Employee Engagement : Provide advice on organisational design & structure and champion employee engagement initiatives to foster a culture of high performance and engagement. › Ensure all operational & life-cycle processes for dedicated client area run smoothly and effectively. For example, responsible for executing new joiner onboarding, amendments, leavers processes etc. › Support the broader Generalist HR team on regulatory change, process improvements, and policy updates. Your profile › At least five years’ HR experience in a fast-paced high-performance environment delivering the best possible outcomes for the business. › Sound knowledge of UK employment laws, employee relations, and regulations and the ability to apply them in live business scenarios. › Proven ability to manage stakeholders, influence, and navigate multiple priorities. › Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build credible relationships across the business. › Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to manage complex and sensitive employee relations matters. Your team Pictet Tech designs, integrates and operates software applications ranging from portfolio management systems and trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while sustaining business operations. You’ll be part of the Cloud Engineering unit. In this unit, we are responsible of streamlining the development experience of product teams by delivering reliable and user-centric platforms covering observability, identity, continuous integration and delivery, release management and cloud capabilities. You will be embedded within the Release Management Team and will help building and maintaining the tooling used to manage and govern the release management at Pictet Tech . Your role
• Designing, building and operating a reliable platform providing release management capabilities to development teams.
• Contributing to the promotion of good practices in terms of Release Management within Pictet Group.
• Aligning with developers, infrastructure engineers, cybersecurity and risk managers to apply standards and to provide guidance.
• Performing tasks expected of a platform engineer: development, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. Your profile
• You have experience in an engineering role (e.g., software engineer, devops, etc.).
• Proficiency in software craftsmanship practices and full stack development (i.e. Java, Spring, Typescript, Angular, Next.js).
• A well-established background in vibe coding paired with a strong passion for AI coding.
• Knowledge about architecture topics such as integration, security, network, identity and access management.
• Strong interest and knowledge of release management processes.
• As a plus, you have expertise in releasing core banking systems or such complex systems within a highly regulated environment.
• Team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. We are looking for a Private Assets Operations Specialist to join our Funds and Private Assets Services unit. Our department belongs to the Operations division, which provides a broad range of custodian and fund administration services. Based in Geneva, you will be joining a dynamic team that plays a central role in supporting the strategic growth of our Private Assets offering. Your role
• Execute subscriptions and transfer orders for Private Equity Funds and Private Placements.
• Book the transactions after confirmation.
• Operate the Organized Trading Facility of Interests.
• Resolve issues arising from reconciliations.
• Coordinate the reception of in-kind distributions.
• Prepare customized advice.
• Support and liaise with internal clients on a daily basis.
• Manage risks associated with Private Assets operations. Your profile
• University degree (Bachelor’s or Master's) in Business and/or Economics, or the equivalent in work experience in the finance industry.
• Experience of 1 to 5 years in Private Assets Operations is a plus.
• Good user of Excel and generally at ease with new IT systems.
• Quick learning ability.
• Rigorous, team player and sense of responsibility.
• Solution-oriented and ability to manage complex cases.
• Fluent in French and English with excellent communication skills.
• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate. titleByLocale.de: Senior Manager - Strategic Planning & Financial Analysis

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk and Taxation. We provide senior management with business and financial insights to enable them to define the strategic priorities of the Group and assist with the planning and monitoring of their implementation. Your role
• Lead a team of financial analysts.
• Manage capital planning for the Group’s main banking entities and at consolidated level, including the analysis and projections of risk-weighted assets.
• Oversee financial forecasting and scenario analysis for Group and business lines.
• Coordinate annual budgets, set targets and recommend resource allocations.
• Prepare business performance reviews, track budget attainment and monitor strategic initiatives.
• Facilitate long-term financial planning and evaluate the impact of proposed initiatives.
• Execute change projects and improve financial reporting tools and processes.
• Analyse market trends and conduct competitive benchmarking. Your profile
• Master’s degree or equivalent in STEM or Finance. MBA is a plus.
• 5-10 years’ experience in a similar role in a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team of a large organisation and a proven project management experience (Consultancy firm experience is a plus).
• Strong analytical skills and sense of ownership; comfortable with numbers and engaging senior stakeholders.
• Skilled presenter able to clearly convey financial insights to management.
• Knowledge of banking/asset management industries and experience with FP&A tools (Anaplan, Tagetik, SAP BPC) preferred.
• Fluent in English and French.
• Must reside in Switzerland or be open to relocation. As the chosen applicant you will be a self-starter, proactive and able to work on your own as well as being keen to join a young, dynamic and impactful team. You will be in contact with senior management across the Group, covering all of our business lines, and will be joining a Group that places emphasis on long-term thinking. You will also be expected to embrace the Group’s values and put these into practice in your daily activities. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. Ref. : SM-SP&FA/CC/CV Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione La tua squadra Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 200 anni di patrimonio bancaria svizzera con competenze di investimento globale. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà dei partner offre una gamma completa di servizi per individui e famiglie facoltose, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consulenziali, e servizi di family office. Mansioni - Servire come punto di ingresso per tutte le richieste operative da parte di banchieri o clienti. - Conducendo il processo di apertura del conto end-to-end, prendendo in considerazione le specificità normative locali che determinano i requisiti di documentazione. - Assicurare un rigoroso follow-up della documentazione (incluse le pendenze, l'ufficio centrale e le liste R&C) contattando i clienti, in coordinamento con il banchiere responsabile del rapporto. - Gestione dei flussi di documentazione (archiviazione e elaborazione di forme fisiche ed elettroniche). - Leading KYC information-gathering se necessario, e l'aggiornamento dei record supplementari nel sistema quando necessario. - Elaborazione delle richieste del flusso di lavoro nel sistema (codifiche dei clienti, richieste di carta di credito, linee di credito, eccezioni di prezzo, ecc.) e garantire la documentazione relativa del cliente è inserita nel sistema (memo, ordini, ecc.). - Coordinare a stretto contatto con Business Risk Manager della zona per risolvere qualsiasi problema di rischio e conformità. - Guidare e organizzare, all'interno del team, la priorità e la bonifica di eventuali Indicatori di rischio chiave contrassegnati. - Aderendo a tutte le politiche e direttive esistenti, e sostenere l'attuazione di nuove, se necessario. - Elaborazione dei pagamenti e dei trasferimenti, assicurando allo stesso tempo che i callback siano sistematicamente eseguiti e fornendo supporto ad altre attività transazionali, se necessario. - Promuovere stretti legami con le parti interessate interne pertinenti (Voyages, Middle Office, R&C, ecc.), imparare su ciò che fanno e agire come punto di contatto per la squadra. - Assicurare la copertura telefonica all'interno della squadra. - Sostenere i compiti amministrativi quando necessario.
• Requisiti - Corso di laurea o simili. - Non meno di 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile. - Fluente in inglese, spagnolo e portoghese; il francese è un vantaggio. - Servizio orientato, con esperienza nel trattare con clienti privati e gestori di relazioni di supporto. - Una stretta comprensione dei compiti di documentazione dei gestori patrimoniali e dei relativi processi interni. - Familiarità con dimensioni regolamentari (transfrontaliera, R&C, PEP, CARA, FATCA, CRS ecc.). - Attenzione ai dettagli. - In grado di lavorare in modo indipendente e diligente. - Affidabile e resiliente, con un forte senso di responsabilità e una capacità di multi-task. - mentalità orientata alla soluzione e proattiva. - Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione, sia scritta che orale. - Forte spirito di squadra. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive range of services for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions, and family office services. As a Client Relationship Officer, you will be responsible for all operational aspects of daily banking activities. Your role will be to deliver a world-class client experience. Your role
• Serving as the point of entry for all operational requests from bankers or clients.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Pictet has been present in London since 1980, and employs near 400 people. Pictet Asset Management (PAM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service. Your role As an Investment Risk Manager with an ESG tilt, working in close proximity with investment teams, you will provide support for the appropriate implementation and ongoing development of our sustainability and ESG related risk management framework. Whilst your primary focus will be on ESG-related risks management, you will also assist in the continued development of 2nd Line of Defence (L2) investment risk and regulatory risk activities. Reporting to the Head of ManCo Risk Management, you will assist in:
• Strengthening PAM’s ESG-related risk management oversight and control framework.
• Designing key risk and controls to identify, measure, and manage ESG-related risks associated with fund’s investment strategies.
• Assisting with the continued development and implementation of PAM’s ESG-related risk policy.
• Ensuring that regulatory risks and investment risks are identified and appropriately managed for PAM funds and investment mandates.
• Routinely monitoring portfolios, analysing investment risks and portfolio deviations.
• Maintaining and updating fund risk profiles and ensuring that policies and procedures related to these activities are updated and maintained.
• Ensuring that issues identified are escalated in a timely manner.
• Contributing to risk reporting to the governing bodies (e.g. executive management, Board of Directors).
• Contributing to preparation of responses to regulators’ requests about risk-related topics. Your profile
• University degree or equivalent qualification.
• 3 to 5 years' prior experience in investment and regulatory risk management in the asset management industry with a sound understanding of ESG regulatory requirements, and ESG related risks. You will have acquired experience implementing ESG Risk Management frameworks and have practical experience of managing ESG-related risks.
• In-depth understanding of the asset management industry (portfolio management, trading, administration and fund distribution).
• Sound understanding of the regulatory environments in which PAM operations, including Switzerland, Luxembourg, and the UK.
• Skilled user of standard IT applications (MS Office).
• Coding experience is an asset (Python and/or other coding languages).
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• As the successful applicant, you are motivated and passionate about sustainability topics. You will be proactive, disciplined and have a structured mindset; able to identify, analyse and solve issues.
• You will also have strong problem-solving skills coupled with an ability to develop creative approaches, models and systems. In addition, you will possess strong interpersonal skills, and be team orientated.
• CFA, CAIA or FRM would be an advantageous.
• Fluent in English. French and German would be an asset. This role can be based in either London or Geneva. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services. We are looking for a long-term intern to join our Private Wealth Management Investement & Wealth Solutions department. You will be responsible to provide support to credit managers in their daily work, for all branches of BPAG and from an operational perspective.
• Start date: ASAP
• Duration: 12 months
• Employment rate: part-time
• Prerequisite: a tripartite internship agreement signed with your school Your role
• Support in the preparation of regular reports for the attention of the Front Office and Management (past due credit limits, upcoming credit limits maturities, Missing Documentation).
• Perform manual monitoring of credit structures and collateral requirements (“special monitoring” situations that cannot be handled automatically).
• Handling of standard operational tasks such as credit card guarantees approval and booking, approval on repurchase requests on insurance policies, manual update of interest conditions on client’s current accounts etc.
• Monitor the conditions set when the credit request is approved.
• Draft simple credit documentation for standard cases (Luxembourg) and verify documentation prepared by other branches.
• Tracking and follow-up of overdue credits. Your profile Qualifications and experience:
• Currently puirsing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Economics or other related field

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive range of services for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions, and family office services. As a Client Relationship Officer, you will be responsible for all operational aspects of daily banking activities. Your role will be to deliver a world-class client experience. Your role
• Serving as the point of entry for all operational requests from bankers or clients.
• Leading the end-to-end account-opening process, taking the local regulatory specificities that determine documentation requirements into consideration.
• Ensuring a strict follow-up of documentation (including pendings, middle office andR&C lists) by contacting clients, in coordination with the banker in charge of the relationship.
• Managing documentation flows (archiving and processing physical and electronic forms).
• Leading KYC information-gathering where required, and updating supplementary records in the system when needed.
• Processing workflow requests in the system (client codifications, credit card requests, credit lines, pricing exceptions, etc.) and ensuring relevant client documentation is entered into the system (memos, orders, etc.).
• Coordinating closely with the zone’s Business Risk Manager to resolve any risk and compliance matters.
• Leading and organising, within the team, the prioritisation and remediation of any Key Risk Indicators flagged.
• Adhering to all existing policies and directives, and support the implementation of new ones where needed.
• Processing payments and transfers, while ensuring callbacks are systematically performed, and providing support for other transactional activities where needed.
• Fostering close ties with the relevant internal stakeholders (Voyages, Middle Office, R&C, etc.), learning about what they do and acting as their point of contact for the team.
• Ensuring telephone call coverage within the team.
• Supporting administrative tasks where required. Your profile
• Bachelor's degree or similar.
• No less than 5 years’ experience in a similar role.
• Fluent in English and Spanish; French and Portuguese an advantage.
• Service orientated, with experience in dealing with private clients and supporting relationship managers.
• Firm grasp of wealth managers’ client documentation duties and related internal processes.
• Familiarity with regulatory dimensions (cross-border, R&C, PEP, CARA, FATCA, CRS etc.).
• Attention to detail.
• Able to work independently and diligently.
• Reliable and resilient, with a strong sense of responsibility and an ability to multi-task.
• Solution-oriented and proactive mindset.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral.
• Strong team spirit. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Ref.:"FT/CRO/MB" Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. titleByLocale.it: Risk Manager (contratto a tempo determinato 9 mesi)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Pictet Asset Management (Pictet AM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service. Your role You will reinforce the team by helping to ensure that all inherent risks associated with Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled funds are properly managed, assist with the continued development and implementation of the Pictet AM ManCo Risk Management framework including the investment risk management framework, and by helping the Head of ManCo Risk to provide senior management with information about the risks facing the business and the effectiveness of mitigating actions. Your tasks will include :
• Assisting the Head of ManCo Risk in ensuring that investment risks are identified and appropriately managed.
• Ensuring that regulatory risks for Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled funds are properly managed.
• Independently reviewing and assessing potential investment breaches for Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled funds.
• Overseeing delegated investment controlling activities and risk management capabilities of delegated portfolio managers.
• Maintaining and updating fund risk profiles and ensuring that policies and procedures related to the activity are properly updated and maintained.
• Contributing to Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled fund events management (e.g. launches, mergers, etc.) from a risk perspective, and overseeing these events.
• Maintaining and updating fund risk profiles and ensuring that policies and procedures related to the activity are properly updated and maintained.
• Contributing to risk reporting to the governing bodies (e.g. executive management, Board of Directors).
• Contributing to preparing responses to regulators’ requests about risk-related topics and to the oversight of counterparty risk . Your profile
• University degree (undergraduate or postgraduate), or a qualification deemed equivalent.
• CFA, CAIA or FRM would be an asset.
• Three to five years’ experience in a similar role (investment and regulatory risk management) in the asset management industry.
• In-depth understanding of the asset management industry (portfolio management, trading, administration and fund distribution).
• Experience in counterparty risk management.
• Good knowledge of Swiss requirements in terms of risk management and of Swiss regulations for asset management and funds (knowledge of the Luxembourg regulatory environment would be an asset).
• Sound financial knowledge.
• Fluent in French and English; German would be a plus.
• Skilled user of standard IT applications (MS Office).
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate. Ref: RM/CT/ETNT Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. Pictet Asset Management (Pictet AM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service. Your role You will reinforce the team by helping to ensure that all inherent risks associated with Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled funds are properly managed, assist with the continued development and implementation of the Pictet AM ManCo Risk Management framework including the investment risk management framework, and by helping the Head of ManCo Risk to provide senior management with information about the risks facing the business and the effectiveness of mitigating actions. Your tasks will include :
• Assisting the Head of ManCo Risk in ensuring that investment risks are identified and appropriately managed.
• Ensuring that regulatory risks for Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled funds are properly managed.
• Independently reviewing and assessing potential investment breaches for Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled funds.
• Overseeing delegated investment controlling activities and risk management capabilities of delegated portfolio managers.
• Maintaining and updating fund risk profiles and ensuring that policies and procedures related to the activity are properly updated and maintained.
• Contributing to Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled fund events management (e.g. launches, mergers, etc.) from a risk perspective, and overseeing these events.
• Maintaining and updating fund risk profiles and ensuring that policies and procedures related to the activity are properly updated and maintained.
• Contributing to risk reporting to the governing bodies (e.g. executive management, Board of Directors).
• Contributing to preparing responses to regulators’ requests about risk-related topics and to the oversight of counterparty risk . Your profile
• University degree (undergraduate or postgraduate), or a qualification deemed equivalent.
• CFA, CAIA or FRM would be an asset.
• Three to five years’ experience in a similar role (investment and regulatory risk management) in the asset management industry.
• In-depth understanding of the asset management industry (portfolio management, trading, administration and fund distribution).
• Experience in counterparty risk management.
• Good knowledge of Swiss requirements in terms of risk management and of Swiss regulations for asset management and funds (knowledge of the Luxembourg regulatory environment would be an asset).
• Sound financial knowledge.
• Fluent in French and English; German would be a plus.
• Skilled user of standard IT applications (MS Office).
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Pictet North America Advisors SA (PNAA) provides investment services to private clients. Founded in 2007, the SEC-registered company devises portfolio diversification strategies for clients based in the US and Canada. We are seeking to recruit a Client Relationship Officer for our US clients (UHNWI) on an 8 months contract. You will be working for PNAA in Geneva and will be the point of entry for all operational requests from relationship managers or clients. As most of our clients custody their assets with Banque Pictet & Cie SA, you will also work closely with its organization for outsourced custodian activities. Your role Your responsibilities will include the following:
• Assisting the CRM with daily client-related tasks (debit list, maturities, etc.).
• Processing payments and transfers while ensuring that call-backs are systematically performed, and assisting with other transactional activities when needed.
• Ensuring strict follow-up of documentation (pending items, Middle Office, Risk & Compliance lists) by contacting clients, together with the CRM responsible for the relationship.
• Managing documentation flows (archiving and processing physical and electronic forms).
• Processing workflow requests in the systems (client codifications, credit card requests, credit lines, pricing exceptions, etc.) and ensuring that the relevant client documentation is captured in the systems (memos, orders, etc.).
• Working closely with the zone’s COO and CCO to resolve any Risk & Compliance matters.
• Leading and organizing the prioritization and remediation of Key Risk Indicators within the team.
• Building close relationships and an understanding with the relevant custodian stakeholders (Middle Office, Client Registrar, Risk & Compliance, etc.) and serving as their point of contact for the team.
• Ensuring that all telephone calls received by the team are dealt with.
• Helping with administrative tasks when required. Your profile
• Certification in Commerce/Banking, or an equivalent qualification.
• Minimum of 2–3 years’ experience as an assistant working in private banking.
• Service-oriented, with experience and understanding of dealing with private clients and assisting relationship managers.
• Understanding client documentation and the internal processes of a wealth management company
• Keen attention to detail.
• Able to work independently and diligently.
• Reliable and resilient with a strong sense of responsibility and an ability to multi-task.
• Solution-oriented and with a proactive mindset.
• Excellent communication skills, both written and oral.
• Keen sense of ethics, values and partnership culture.
• Strong team spirit.
• Fluency in English and French.
• Must be resident in Switzerland. Start date: ASAP Ref: CRO/CC/JJV Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. The division delivers high-quality operational services to business lines including Wealth Management, Asset Services and Asset Management. As Fund Distribution Commissions Specialist , you will be part of the Investment Fund Commissions team and responsible for processing trailer fee commissions for our clients across all the Pictet group entities, while contributing to the continuous improvement of processes through the integration of advanced technical solutions and automation tools. Your role
• Calculate, reconcile and allocate trailer fee commissions in accordance with contractual agreements and internal policies.
• Maintain accurate records of commission structures and ensure data integrity.
• Prepare regular and ad hoc reports on commission payments, outstanding balances, and related metrics for management and stakeholders.
• Actively contribute to IT-focused projects, optimizing operational workflows through the implementation of automated solutions and advanced technologies.
• Act as the point of contact for queries related to commission payments.
• Ensure activities comply with regulations, internal controls, and audit requirements.
• Support the onboarding of new relationships. Your profile
• Bachelor’s degree in finance, IT or equivalent qualification.
• Experience in banking operations and understanding of investment funds and distribution channels are important assets, but it is not a decisive criterion if your profile demonstrates a strong ability to structure and optimize processes.
• Strong interest in automation and new technologies with the ability to design and maintain automated operational tools and solutions (e.g., Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, AI agents, etc.) is a valued asset.
• Analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
• Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Collaborative approach, with a willingness to support colleagues and contribute to a positive team environment.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in French and English, with the ability to interact effectively with both internal and external stakeholders. Note FDCS/JLS/MAB/ We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Votre équipe Le Groupe Pictet, fondé en 1805, possède son siège à Genève en Suisse. Le Groupe est établi dans le monde entier (31 bureaux) et emploie actuellement plus de 5000 personnes. La division Pictet Wealth Management offre depuis plus de 200 ans à ses clients une gamme étendue de services bancaires et une expertise mondiale en matière d'investissement. En tant que Client Relationship Officer vous serez rattaché/e au service Marché – France de la division Pictet Wealth Management à Paris. Vous assisterez plusieurs banquiers dans tous les aspects de la gestion administrative et opérationnelle des comptes clients d’une part, et assurerez diverses tâches de support à l’activité de planification financière d’autre part. Votre rôle
• Être l’interlocuteur/trice de référence pour toutes les demandes opérationnelles des banquiers et des clients, en assurant un service de qualité et une communication proactive.
• Faciliter toutes les étapes du processus d’ouverture de compte, en veillant au respect des prescriptions réglementaires locales et à la complétude des documents requis.
• Gérer et suivre les opérations courantes : codifications de compte, tarification, renouvellement des limites de crédit, opérations de paiement et de transfert, appels de vérification, etc.
• Assurer un suivi rigoureux de la documentation (suspens, remédiation, listes Risk & Compliance) et, dans ce cadre, contacter les clients en coordination avec les banquiers responsables des relations concernées.
• Générer, personnaliser et transmettre les reportings financiers et administratifs aux clients et partenaires ; récupérer les situations des contrats et demander les reportings spécifiques aux équipes internes.
• Suivre les soldes débiteurs : monitorer les comptes, contacter les clients pour définir un plan d’action, effectuer les transferts ou ventes d’actifs nécessaires, et coordonner avec les équipes concernées.
• Traiter les opérations spécifiques liées à l’assurance vie et à la gestion de contrats : réception et gestion des mandats de gestion, arbitrages, instructions de désinvestissement, résiliations, changements de contraintes, de tarification, etc.
• Assurer la prise en charge des appels téléphoniques et le soutien au sein de l’équipe.
• Contribuer à la collecte et à la mise à jour des informations KYC dans les systèmes internes.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes pour garantir la fluidité des opérations. Votre profil
• Bachelor ou formation jugée équivalente.
• 5 ans d’expérience minimum en tant que Client Relationship Officer (ou poste équivalent) dans une banque privée, idéalement au sein d’un établissement majeur du secteur.
• Aptitude à travailler avec plusieurs banquiers et sur deux activités différentes.
• À l’aise dans un environnement informatique complexe et évolutif, avec la capacité d’utiliser efficacement de nombreux outils spécifiques à la banque privée.
• Bonne vision transversale des différents départements de la banque privée, ainsi qu’une compréhension des rôles et des interactions entre chaque service.
• Connaissance des dispositifs et prescriptions réglementaires (activités transfrontalières, gestion des risques et compliance, PEP, relations à risques accrus, FATCA, norme commune de déclaration, etc.).
• Le français est votre langue maternelle.
• Très bonne compréhension écrite et orale de l’anglais. Précis/e, méticuleux/se et organisé/e tout en sachant faire preuve de flexibilité et de discrétion, vous êtes doté/e d’une excellente présentation et prenez volontiers des responsabilités. Doté/e d’une très bonne capacité d’adaptation et sachant parfaitement gérer les priorités, vous êtes polyvalent/e et travaillez aisément pour deux activités et équipes différentes. Vous savez faire preuve d’initiative et travailler de manière autonome, tout en respectant la confidentialité des activités dont vous avez la charge. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversité & Inclusion Pictet est un employeur qui respecte l’égalité des chances et favorise la diversité. Le respect des personnes et l’inclusion au travail sont au cœur de nos préoccupations. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Votre équipe Le Groupe Pictet, fondé en 1805, possède son siège à Genève en Suisse. Le Groupe est établi dans le monde entier (31 bureaux) et emploie actuellement plus de 5000 personnes. La division Pictet Wealth Management offre depuis plus de 200 ans à ses clients une gamme étendue de services bancaires et une expertise mondiale en matière d'investissement. En tant que Client Relationship Officer vous serez rattaché/e au service Marché – France de la division Pictet Wealth Management à Paris. Vous assisterez plusieurs banquiers dans tous les aspects de la gestion administrative et opérationnelle des comptes clients d’une part, et assurerez diverses tâches de support à l’activité de planification financière d’autre part. Votre rôle
• Être l’interlocuteur/trice de référence pour toutes les demandes opérationnelles des banquiers et des clients, en assurant un service de qualité et une communication proactive.
• Faciliter toutes les étapes du processus d’ouverture de compte, en veillant au respect des prescriptions réglementaires locales et à la complétude des documents requis.
• Gérer et suivre les opérations courantes : codifications de compte, tarification, renouvellement des limites de crédit, opérations de paiement et de transfert, appels de vérification, etc.
• Assurer un suivi rigoureux de la documentation (suspens, remédiation, listes Risk & Compliance) et, dans ce cadre, contacter les clients en coordination avec les banquiers responsables des relations concernées.
• Générer, personnaliser et transmettre les reportings financiers et administratifs aux clients et partenaires ; récupérer les situations des contrats et demander les reportings spécifiques aux équipes internes.
• Suivre les soldes débiteurs : monitorer les comptes, contacter les clients pour définir un plan d’action, effectuer les transferts ou ventes d’actifs nécessaires, et coordonner avec les équipes concernées.
• Traiter les opérations spécifiques liées à l’assurance vie et à la gestion de contrats : réception et gestion des mandats de gestion, arbitrages, instructions de désinvestissement, résiliations, changements de contraintes, de tarification, etc.
• Assurer la prise en charge des appels téléphoniques et le soutien au sein de l’équipe.
• Contribuer à la collecte et à la mise à jour des informations KYC dans les systèmes internes.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes pour garantir la fluidité des opérations. Votre profil
• Bachelor ou formation jugée équivalente.
• 5 ans d’expérience minimum en tant que Client Relationship Officer (ou poste équivalent) dans une banque privée, idéalement au sein d’un établissement majeur du secteur.
• Aptitude à travailler avec plusieurs banquiers et sur deux activités différentes.
• À l’aise dans un environnement informatique complexe et évolutif, avec la capacité d’utiliser efficacement de nombreux outils spécifiques à la banque privée.
• Bonne vision transversale des différents départements de la banque privée, ainsi qu’une compréhension des rôles et des interactions entre chaque service.
• Connaissance des dispositifs et prescriptions réglementaires (activités transfrontalières, gestion des risques et compliance, PEP, relations à risques accrus, FATCA, norme commune de déclaration, etc.).
• Le français est votre langue maternelle.
• Très bonne compréhension écrite et orale de l’anglais. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Tech division specialises in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the Pictet Tech division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients. As a Cyber Risk & Compliance Manager within Pictet Tech, you will be part of a dynamic Tech & Cyber Risk Management department based in Geneva. You will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing the Internal Control System for cybersecurity processes for the Pictet Tech division. In this pivotal role, you will assess the design and performance of cybersecurity controls and conduct risk analyses to evaluate the impact of cyber threats. Your mission will also include overseeing the development and alignment of cybersecurity documentation and practices with regulatory requirements. Your role
• Maintain the Internal Control System in relation to cybersecurity processes at the Tech level, in order to manage cyber risk in an effective manner.
• Assess the design and performance of 1st level cybersecurity controls carried out by Tech teams, and support the annual risk & control self assessments.
• Perform risk analyses and contribute to assessing the impact of emerging cyber threats on Pictet’s Tech landscape.
• Oversee the development, maintenance and review of cybersecurity documentation, including policies, standards and procedures. Ensure these are aligned with regulatory requirements.
• Serve as the principal point of contact for regulatory reviews and external audits related to cybersecurity.
• Perform regular 2nd level controls (e.g. shadow cloud, access bypass, etc.).
• Play an active role within the Risk & Compliance team, contributing to KPI & KRI documentation, providing cybersecurity support to IT projects and leading follow-up on improvement actions resulting from incidents, assessments or audits. Your profile
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, or a related field.
• 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity risk management, consulting or audit, with a strong foundation in technical concepts and practices.
• Proven expertise in Identity and Access Management and Privileged Access Management solutions, with successful track records in implementation, monitoring, and optimisation.
• Strong grasp of cyber hygiene best practices, including experience with CIS baseline controls across endpoints, databases and servers. Ability to design and enforce IT infrastructure security policies.
• Familiarity with financial sector cyber related regulations (FINMA, BaFin, MAS, HKMA, DORA, etc).
• Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM or equivalent) is a plus.
• Self-driven, proactive and solution-oriented mindset with excellent problem-solving skills.
• Fluency in both French and English, with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Residency in Switzerland or willingness to relocate. Ref. CR&CM/CRO/RB Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. Your team The Group Corporate Functions division offers Pictet Group clients and employees a wide range of services; it manages the Group’s headquarters in Geneva as well as its subsidiaries, branches and offices in Switzerland and abroad, and ensures their physical security. To strengthen the Event Management team, our Geneva office is seeking to hire an Event Manager. Your role Oversee the design, planning and execution of internal and external events for the Pictet Group, ensuring they run smoothly, align with the company’s strategic objectives and enhance the Group’s image. Key responsibilities:
• Oversee the entire operational process of events, from defining requirements to execution.
• Coordinate internal and external stakeholders (vendors, internal teams, partners).
• Ensure the quality, consistency and image of the Group at every event.
• Work closely with the marketing and communications teams of the various business lines to design tailored offerings.
• Participate in the development and promotion of the catalogue of internal and external event services.
• Contribute to the opening and operation of the Group’s new event spaces. Specific tasks:
• Prepare event specifications and budgets.
• Select and manage vendors and negotiate rates (venues, caterers, technical aspects, etc.).
• Oversee logistics (food and beverage, relocations, travel, accommodations).
• Maintain communication with teams before, during and after the event.
• Manage unforeseen issues and handle post-event follow-up (review, feedback).
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures and quality standards.
• Propose innovations and continuous improvements in event organisation. Your profile
• Advanced degree in communication, marketing, event management or equivalent.
• Proven experience in event management, ideally in the luxury, banking or institutional sectors (minimum 5 to 8 years).
• Excellent organizational, interpersonal and writing skills.
• Ability to work in a team and rally others around shared projects.
• Diligence, independence, creativity, stress management and a service-oriented mindset.
• Fluency in French and English (spoken and written).
• Proficiency in office software.
• Residence in Switzerland required. Ref.  Plongez au cœur de l’univers bancaire durant vos 4 ans de formation à la Haute école de gestion (HEG).

 Vous aurez l’opportunité de découvrir plusieurs services des opérations bancaires à travers des rotations enrichissantes. En collaborant étroitement avec nos équipes, vous participerez activement aux opérations quotidiennes de la Banque, tout en veillant à l’efficacité et à la conformité des processus.

 Ce programme unique vous permettra de développer vos compétences et d’acquérir une connaissance approfondie des métiers de la banque privée.

 Your role

 

• Contribuer activement aux projets et missions confiés par les responsables des différents services lors de vos rotations.

• Vous adapter rapidement à un environnement professionnel exigeant et dynamique, au cœur de la banque privée.

• Développer vos compétences techniques et relationnelles en collaborant avec des experts du secteur bancaire.

 

 Your profile

 Vous souhaitez intégrer la Haute Ecole de Gestion en emploi à 60% pour allier vos études à une expérience professionnelle enrichissante.

 Avec de bons résultats scolaires et témoignant d’un réel intérêt pour le domaine bancaire, vous êtes motivé/e à développer vos compétences et à mettre vos connaissances en pratique dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant.

 Organisé/e, rigoureux/se, curieux/se et persévérant/e, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et communiquez avec aisance. Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français, disposez de bonnes bases en anglais, et la connaissance d’une autre langue est un atout. A l’aise avec les outils informatiques courants MS Office, vous êtes domicilié/e en Suisse et prêt/e à relever ce défi. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

 

 The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk and Taxation.

 

 The Financial Institutions Management (FIM) team, part of the Finance Department, is the Group's centre of expertise for managing relationships with financial institutions. As a key member of this team, you will help maintain and enhance the Group's vital relationships with our financial counterparties.

 Your role

 

 We are seeking a proactive and analytical professional to take ownership of optimising data management, streamlining workflows, and driving process automation across the team's activities. You will lead the transformation and implementation of these initiatives to ensure continuous improvement and innovation.

 
You will be responsible for the following tasks:

 
Process improvement and automation

 • Analyse and map current processes, systems and tools across the team's activities.
• Identify inefficiencies and take the initiative to propose and implement improvements.
• Take ownership of automation solutions and drive the digital transformation of our workflows, leveraging advanced analytics and the latest technologies.
• Reduce reliance on manual processes and email-based requests by introducing robust, scalable solutions.

 Data Management and Quality

 • Maintain and enhance financial counterparty master data (codification, static data).
• Lead efforts to build and manage a centralised “golden source” of data, ensuring high data quality and consistency.
• Implement and monitor automated data quality controls, ensuring data reconciliation and consistency across systems.

 Reporting and Monitoring

 • Prepare impactful dashboards reports, and presentations for internal teams and senior management, using state-of-the-art data visualisation tools.
• Participate in projects that impact the team's activities, driving innovation, efficiency and the adoption of new data science methodologies.

 Your profile

 

 • Master’s degree or equivalent.
• 3 to 5 years of experience and keen interest in banking, or previous experience in the banking industry. 
• Experience in KYC/AML would be a plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and able to take initiative, structured, with strong attention to detail.
• Committed, results-driven and accountable.
• Strong team spirit with the ability to collaborate across teams and business lines.
• Keen interest in process improvement, automation and data visualisation, leveraging technology.
• Experience in SQL and Python.
• Experience with Business Intelligence Tools (Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau) and in Gen AI project implementation.
• Familiarity with data management concepts (data quality/governance).
• Fluent in French and English; other languages are a plus.
• Must be resident in Switzerland.

 Note

 We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

 Ref. : D&PAFC/CC/AK

 Diversity & Inclusion

 Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Your team

 The Pictet Tech division specialises in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the Pictet Tech division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.
As a Cyber Risk & Compliance Manager within Pictet Tech, you will be part of a dynamic Tech & Cyber Risk Management department based in Geneva. You will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing the Internal Control System for cybersecurity processes for the Pictet Tech division. In this pivotal role, you will assess the design and performance of cybersecurity controls and conduct risk analyses to evaluate the impact of cyber threats. Your mission will also include overseeing the development and alignment of cybersecurity documentation and practices with regulatory requirements.

 Your role

 

• Maintain the Internal Control System in relation to cybersecurity processes at the Tech level, in order to manage cyber risk in an effective manner.

• Assess the design and performance of 1st level cybersecurity controls carried out by Tech teams, and support the annual risk & control self assessments.

• Perform risk analyses and contribute to assessing the impact of emerging cyber threats on Pictet’s Tech landscape.

• Oversee the development, maintenance and review of cybersecurity documentation, including policies, standards and procedures. Ensure these are aligned with regulatory requirements.

• Serve as the principal point of contact for regulatory reviews and external audits related to cybersecurity.

• Perform regular 2nd level controls (e.g. shadow cloud, access bypass, etc.).

• Play an active role within the Risk & Compliance team, contributing to KPI & KRI documentation, providing cybersecurity support to IT projects and leading follow-up on improvement actions resulting from incidents, assessments or audits.

 

 Your profile

 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, or a related field.

• 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity risk management, consulting or audit, with a strong foundation in technical concepts and practices.

• Proven expertise in Identity and Access Management and Privileged Access Management solutions, with successful track records in implementation, monitoring, and optimisation.

• Strong grasp of cyber hygiene best practices, including experience with CIS baseline controls across endpoints, databases and servers. Ability to design and enforce IT infrastructure security policies.

• Familiarity with financial sector cyber related regulations (FINMA, BaFin, MAS, HKMA, DORA, etc).

• Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM or equivalent) is a plus.

• Self-driven, proactive and solution-oriented mindset with excellent problem-solving skills.

• Fluency in both French and English, with strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Residency in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.

 
 Ref. CR&CM/CRO/RB

 Note

 We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Votre équipe

 Le Groupe Pictet, fondé en 1805, possède son siège à Genève en Suisse. Le Groupe est établi dans le monde entier (31 bureaux) et emploie actuellement plus de 5000 personnes. La division Pictet Wealth Management offre depuis plus de 200 ans à ses clients une gamme étendue de services bancaires et une expertise mondiale en matière d'investissement.

 

 En tant que Client Relationship Officer vous serez rattaché/e au service Marché – France de la division Pictet Wealth Management à Paris. Vous assisterez plusieurs banquiers dans tous les aspects de la gestion administrative et opérationnelle des comptes clients d’une part, et assurerez diverses tâches de support à l’activité de planification financière d’autre part.

 Votre rôle

 

• Être l’interlocuteur/trice de référence pour toutes les demandes opérationnelles des banquiers et des clients, en assurant un service de qualité et une communication proactive.

• Faciliter toutes les étapes du processus d’ouverture de compte, en veillant au respect des prescriptions réglementaires locales et à la complétude des documents requis.

• Gérer et suivre les opérations courantes : codifications de compte, tarification, renouvellement des limites de crédit, opérations de paiement et de transfert, appels de vérification, etc.

• Assurer un suivi rigoureux de la documentation (suspens, remédiation, listes Risk & Compliance) et, dans ce cadre, contacter les clients en coordination avec les banquiers responsables des relations concernées.

• Générer, personnaliser et transmettre les reportings financiers et administratifs aux clients et partenaires ; récupérer les situations des contrats et demander les reportings spécifiques aux équipes internes.

• Suivre les soldes débiteurs : monitorer les comptes, contacter les clients pour définir un plan d’action, effectuer les transferts ou ventes d’actifs nécessaires, et coordonner avec les équipes concernées.

• Traiter les opérations spécifiques liées à l’assurance vie et à la gestion de contrats : réception et gestion des mandats de gestion, arbitrages, instructions de désinvestissement, résiliations, changements de contraintes, de tarification, etc.

• Assurer la prise en charge des appels téléphoniques et le soutien au sein de l’équipe.

• Contribuer à la collecte et à la mise à jour des informations KYC dans les systèmes internes.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes pour garantir la fluidité des opérations.

 

 Votre profil

 

• Bachelor ou formation jugée équivalente.

• 5 ans d’expérience minimum en tant que Client Relationship Officer (ou poste équivalent) dans une banque privée, idéalement au sein d’un établissement majeur du secteur.

• Aptitude à travailler avec plusieurs banquiers et sur deux activités différentes. 

• À l’aise dans un environnement informatique complexe et évolutif, avec la capacité d’utiliser efficacement de nombreux outils spécifiques à la banque privée.

• Bonne vision transversale des différents départements de la banque privée, ainsi qu’une compréhension des rôles et des interactions entre chaque service.

• Connaissance des dispositifs et prescriptions réglementaires (activités transfrontalières, gestion des risques et compliance, PEP, relations à risques accrus, FATCA, norme commune de déclaration, etc.).

• Le français est votre langue maternelle.

• Très bonne compréhension écrite et orale de l’anglais.

 
 

 Précis/e, méticuleux/se et organisé/e tout en sachant faire preuve de flexibilité et de discrétion, vous êtes doté/e d’une excellente présentation et prenez volontiers des responsabilités.

 Doté/e d’une très bonne capacité d’adaptation et sachant parfaitement gérer les priorités, vous êtes polyvalent/e et travaillez aisément pour deux activités et équipes différentes.

 Vous savez faire preuve d’initiative et travailler de manière autonome, tout en respectant la confidentialité des activités dont vous avez la charge.

 Note

 We will not accept any CVs via agencies

 Diversité & Inclusion

 Pictet est un employeur qui respecte l’égalité des chances et favorise la diversité. Le respect des personnes et l’inclusion au travail sont au cœur de nos préoccupations.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

 The Group Corporate Functions division offers Pictet Group clients and employees a wide range of services; it manages the Group’s headquarters in Geneva as well as its subsidiaries, branches and offices in Switzerland and abroad, and ensures their physical security.

 To strengthen the Event Management team, our Geneva office is seeking to hire an Event Manager.

 Your role

 Oversee the design, planning and execution of internal and external events for the Pictet Group, ensuring they run smoothly, align with the company’s strategic objectives and enhance the Group’s image.

 Key responsibilities:

 

• Oversee the entire operational process of events, from defining requirements to execution.

• Coordinate internal and external stakeholders (vendors, internal teams, partners).

• Ensure the quality, consistency and image of the Group at every event.

• Work closely with the marketing and communications teams of the various business lines to design tailored offerings.

• Participate in the development and promotion of the catalogue of internal and external event services.

• Contribute to the opening and operation of the Group’s new event spaces.

 
 Specific tasks:

 

• Prepare event specifications and budgets.

• Select and manage vendors and negotiate rates (venues, caterers, technical aspects, etc.).

• Oversee logistics (food and beverage, relocations, travel, accommodations).

• Maintain communication with teams before, during and after the event.

• Manage unforeseen issues and handle post-event follow-up (review, feedback).

• Ensure compliance with internal procedures and quality standards.

• Propose innovations and continuous improvements in event organisation.

 

 Your profile

 

• Advanced degree in communication, marketing, event management or equivalent.

• Proven experience in event management, ideally in the luxury, banking or institutional sectors (minimum 5 to 8 years).

• Excellent organizational, interpersonal and writing skills.

• Ability to work in a team and rally others around shared projects.

• Diligence, independence, creativity, stress management and a service-oriented mindset.

• Fluency in French and English (spoken and written).

• Proficiency in office software.

• Residence in Switzerland required.

 
 Ref. EM/SBP/AKL

 Note

 We will not accept any CVs via agencies

 Diversity & Inclusion

 Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

 

 The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk and Taxation.

 

 We provide senior management with business and financial insights to enable them to define the strategic priorities of the Group and assist with the planning and monitoring of their implementation.

 Your role

 

 • Lead a team of financial analysts.
• Manage capital planning for the Group’s main banking entities and at consolidated level, including the analysis and projections of risk-weighted assets.
• Oversee financial forecasting and scenario analysis for Group and business lines.
• Coordinate annual budgets, set targets and recommend resource allocations.
• Prepare business performance reviews, track budget attainment and monitor strategic initiatives.
• Facilitate long-term financial planning and evaluate the impact of proposed initiatives.
• Execute change projects and improve financial reporting tools and processes.
• Analyse market trends and conduct competitive benchmarking.

 Your profile

 

 • Master’s degree or equivalent in STEM or Finance. MBA is a plus.
• 5-10 years’ experience in a similar role in a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team of a large organisation and a proven project management experience (Consultancy firm experience is a plus).
• Strong analytical skills and sense of ownership; comfortable with numbers and engaging senior stakeholders.
• Skilled presenter able to clearly convey financial insights to management.
• Knowledge of banking/asset management industries and experience with FP&A tools (Anaplan, Tagetik, SAP BPC) preferred.
• Fluent in English and French.
• Must reside in Switzerland or be open to relocation.

 

 As the chosen applicant you will be a self-starter, proactive and able to work on your own as well as being keen to join a young, dynamic and impactful team. You will be in contact with senior management across the Group, covering all of our business lines, and will be joining a Group that places emphasis on long-term thinking. You will also be expected to embrace the Group’s values and put these into practice in your daily activities.

 Note

 

 We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

 

 Ref. : SM-SP&FA/CC/CV

 Diversity & Inclusion

 

 Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Vous aurez l’opportunité de découvrir plusieurs services des opérations bancaires à travers des rotations enrichissantes. descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo team

Immergiti nel mondo bancario durante i tuoi 4 anni di formazione presso la Haute école de gestion (HEG).

Avrai l'opportunità di scoprire diversi servizi delle operazioni bancarie attraverso rotazioni arricchenti. Collaborando strettamente con i nostri team, parteciperai attivamente alle operazioni quotidiane della Banca, garantendo al contempo l'efficacia e la conformità dei processi.

Questo programma unico ti permetterà di sviluppare le tue competenze e di acquisire una conoscenza approfondita delle professioni della banca privata.

Il tuo ruolo

- Contribuire attivamente ai progetti e alle missioni affidate dai responsabili dei vari servizi durante le tue rotazioni.
- Adattarti rapidamente a un ambiente professionale esigente e dinamico, al cuore della banca privata.
- Sviluppare le tue competenze tecniche e relazionali collaborando con esperti del settore bancario.

Il tuo profilo

Vuoi entrare a far parte della Haute Ecole de Gestion con un impiego al 60% per combinare i tuoi studi con un'esperienza professionale arricchente.

Con buoni risultati scolastici e dimostrando un reale interesse per il settore bancario, sei motivato/a a sviluppare le tue competenze e a mettere le tue conoscenze in pratica in un ambiente dinamico e stimolante.

Organizzato/a, rigoroso/a, curioso/a e perseverante, apprezzi il lavoro di squadra e comunichi con facilità. Hai una padronanza perfetta del francese, buone basi in inglese e la conoscenza di un'altra lingua è un plus. A tuo agio con gli strumenti informatici comuni MS Office, risiedi in Svizzera e sei pronto/a a cogliere questa sfida. Inviaci subito il tuo dossier completo per unirti al nostro programma!

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie

Diversità & Inclusione

Pictet è un datore di lavoro che promuove l'uguaglianza di opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diversificato. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione nel luogo di lavoro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

Dive into the banking world during your 4 years of training at the Haute école de gestion (HEG).

You will have the opportunity to discover several banking operations services through enriching rotations. By closely collaborating with our teams, you will actively participate in the bank's daily operations, while ensuring the effectiveness and compliance of the processes.

This unique program will allow you to develop your skills and gain in-depth knowledge of private banking professions.

Your role

- Actively contribute to projects and missions entrusted by the heads of the various services during your rotations.
- Quickly adapt to a demanding and dynamic professional environment, at the heart of private banking.
- Develop your technical and interpersonal skills by collaborating with banking sector experts.

Your profile

You wish to join the Haute Ecole de Gestion with a 60% employment to combine your studies with an enriching professional experience.

With good academic results and demonstrating a real interest in the banking sector, you are motivated to develop your skills and put your knowledge into practice in a dynamic and stimulating environment.

Organized, rigorous, curious, and persevering, you appreciate teamwork and communicate with ease. You have a perfect command of French, good bases in English, and knowledge of another language is an asset. At ease with common MS Office computer tools, you reside in Switzerland and are ready to take up this challenge. Send us your complete file now to join our program!

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihr Team

Tauchen Sie während Ihrer 4-jährigen Ausbildung an der Haute école de gestion (HEG) in die Bankenwelt ein.

Sie haben die Möglichkeit, verschiedene Bankoperationsdienste durch bereichernde Rotationen kennenzulernen. Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Teams werden Sie aktiv an den täglichen Bankoperationen teilnehmen und gleichzeitig die Wirksamkeit und Einhaltung der Prozesse sicherstellen.

Dieses einzigartige Programm ermöglicht es Ihnen, Ihre Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln und ein tiefes Verständnis der Berufe im Privatbanking zu erlangen.

Ihre Rolle

- Aktive Mitwirkung an Projekten und Aufgaben, die Ihnen von den Verantwortlichen der verschiedenen Dienstleistungen während Ihrer Rotationen übertragen werden.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk and Taxation.

The Financial Institutions Management (FIM) team, part of the Finance Department, is the Group's centre of expertise for managing relationships with financial institutions. As a key member of this team, you will help maintain and enhance the Group's vital relationships with our financial counterparties.

Your role

We are seeking a proactive and analytical professional to take ownership of optimising data management, streamlining workflows, and driving process automation across the team's activities. You will lead the transformation and implementation of these initiatives to ensure continuous improvement and innovation.

You will be responsible for the following tasks:

Process improvement and automation

- Analyse and map current processes, systems and tools across the team's activities.
- Identify inefficiencies and take the initiative to propose and implement improvements.
- Take ownership of automation solutions and drive the digital transformation of our workflows, leveraging advanced analytics and the latest technologies.
- Reduce reliance on manual processes and email-based requests by introducing robust, scalable solutions.

Data Management and Quality

- Maintain and enhance financial counterparty master data (codification, static data).
- Lead efforts to build and manage a centralised “golden source” of data, ensuring high data quality and consistency.
- Implement and monitor automated data quality controls, ensuring data reconciliation and consistency across systems.

Reporting and Monitoring

- Prepare impactful dashboards reports, and presentations for internal teams and senior management, using state-of-the-art data visualisation tools.
- Participate in projects that impact the team's activities, driving innovation, efficiency and the adoption of new data science methodologies.

Your profile

- Master’s degree or equivalent.
- 3 to 5 years of experience and keen interest in banking, or previous experience in the banking industry.
- Experience in KYC/AML would be a plus.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
- Proactive, solution-oriented and able to take initiative, structured, with strong attention to detail.
- Committed, results-driven and accountable.
- Strong team spirit with the ability to collaborate across teams and business lines.
- Keen interest in process improvement, automation and data visualisation, leveraging technology.
- Experience in SQL and Python.
- Experience with Business Intelligence Tools (Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau) and in Gen AI project implementation.
- Familiarity with data management concepts (data quality/governance).
- Fluent in French and English; other languages are a plus.
- Must be resident in Switzerland.

Note

- We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref.

- D&PAFC/CC/AK

Diversity & Inclusion

- Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo team

La divisione delle Funzioni Aziendali comprende le attività non bancarie del Gruppo e comprende oltre 600 dipendenti. Affiancati da specialisti con esperienza approfondita in tutte le linee di business, le funzioni centrali sono organizzate in vari dipartimenti del Gruppo: Comunicazione, Conformità, Finanza, Risorse Umane, Sicurezza Informatica, Audit Interno, Legale, Ufficio Centrale, Rischio e Tassazione.

Il team di Gestione delle Istituzioni Finanziarie (FIM), parte del Dipartimento Finanza, è il centro di competenza del Gruppo per la gestione delle relazioni con le istituzioni finanziarie. Come membro chiave di questo team, aiuterai a mantenere e migliorare le relazioni vitali del Gruppo con le nostre controparti finanziarie.

Il tuo ruolo

Stiamo cercando un professionista proattivo e analitico che prenda in carico l'ottimizzazione della gestione dei dati, lo streamlining dei flussi di lavoro e la guida dell'automazione dei processi nelle attività del team. Guiderai la trasformazione e l'implementazione di queste iniziative per garantire miglioramenti continui e innovazione.

Sarai responsabile dei seguenti compiti:

Miglioramento e automazione dei processi

- Analizzare e mappare i processi, i sistemi e gli strumenti correnti nelle attività del team.
- Identificare inefficienze e prendere l'iniziativa per proporre e implementare miglioramenti.
- Prendere in carico le soluzioni di automazione e guidare la trasformazione digitale dei nostri flussi di lavoro, sfruttando l'analisi avanzata e le ultime tecnologie.
- Ridurre la dipendenza dai processi manuali e dalle richieste basate su email, introducendo soluzioni robuste e scalabili.

Gestione e qualità dei dati

- Mantenere e migliorare i dati master delle controparti finanziarie (codificazione, dati statici).
- Guidare gli sforzi per costruire e gestire una fonte di dati centralizzata "golden source", garantendo alta qualità e coerenza dei dati.
- Implementare e monitorare i controlli automatizzati di qualità dei dati, garantendo la riconciliazione e la coerenza dei dati tra i sistemi.

Reporting e monitoraggio

- Preparare dashboard, report e presentazioni efficaci per i team interni e la dirigenza, utilizzando strumenti avanzati di visualizzazione dei dati.
- Partecipare a progetti che influenzano le attività del team, guidando innovazione, efficienza e l'adozione di nuove metodologie di data science.

Il tuo profilo

- Laurea magistrale o equivalente.
- 3 a 5 anni di esperienza e forte interesse per il settore bancario, o esperienza precedente nel settore bancario.
- Esperienza in KYC/AML sarebbe un plus.
- Forte mentalità analitica e problem-solving.
- Proattivo, orientato alla soluzione e capace di prendere l'iniziativa, strutturato, con forte attenzione ai dettagli.
- Impegnato, orientato ai risultati e responsabile.
- Forte spirito di squadra con la capacità di collaborare tra team e linee di business.
- Forte interesse per il miglioramento dei processi, l'automazione e la visualizzazione dei dati, sfruttando la tecnologia.
- Esperienza in SQL e Python.
- Esperienza con strumenti di Business Intelligence (Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau) e in implementazione di progetti Gen AI.
- Conoscenza dei concetti di gestione dei dati (qualità/governance).
- Madrelingua francese e inglese; altre lingue sono un plus.
- Deve essere residente in Svizzera.

Nota

- Non accetteremo CV tramite agenzie.

Ref.

- D&PAFC/CC/AK

Diversità e Inclusione

- Pictet è un datore di lavoro che promuove l'uguaglianza di opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diversificato. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione nel luogo di lavoro.

Prozessverbesserung und Automatisierung

- Starke analytische und problemorientierte Denkweise.
- Proaktiv, lösungsorientiert und in der Lage, Initiative zu ergreifen, strukturiert und mit starker Aufmerksamkeit für Details.

- Starkes Teamgeist mit der Fähigkeit, zwischen Teams und Geschäftsbereichen zusammenzuarbeiten.

オルタナティブ投資の中でも、プライベート資産（プライベートエクイティ、プライベートデット、不動産）およびこれらの低流動性資産を組み入れるマルチアセット戦略の開発を担当するプロダクトスペシャリストとして、受託者責任（fiduciary）および説明責任（accountability）を果たしつつ、ビジネスの拡大に貢献していただきます。
